notes.title: Botanical Gardens Preview Tour
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6eea935d83d2ebf896b795ab27602fe0bb8d36ae.jpg[/img]

For some time, we’ve been teasing the Botanical Gardens within Eden Tower--home of the Watson Genomics eco habitat, and the setting for Rogue Update 0.7's new Soul Decrypt mission. Today, we’re showing you a bit more of the evolution and level design of this ambitious environment!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/504c50c538afb2bb1e518c2f3540bf85184227c6.jpg[/img]

Botanical Gardens is the most extensive and detailed environment we have designed yet. Notably, Soul Decrypt is also the most important [i]Raw Data[/i] mission thus far in the story campaign. As you delve into the lush landscapes and the posh interior of Watson Genomics complex, you’ll begin to grasp just how deep Eden’s corruption truly goes: into the human soul itself.

It all begins with a ride on the Eden tram for an ecological tour hosted by your favorite executive assistant: Simon! Welcome aboard...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/5209f0247def897dcfbfc11d52d887e761cde866.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a06edb418e6121369a29a7576f35d0295f3e9448.jpg[/img]
[i]Original concept art for the maglev tram and departure platform.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d7ac97a0cf2c67496c9dbdb8e6f8ede26101f7e1.jpg[/img]
[i]Final in-game render of the tram station.[/i]

As you admire the expanses of scenery throughout this mind-expanding tour and marvel at the genetically-enhanced beauty under the simulated sky, you’ll notice that not everything is as tranquil as it seems. (And it’s not just because Simon’s along for the ride.)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7deae645884d6c6fd1291334861d17cf52a90bfe.gif[/img]
[i]Watson Genomics has only the best security Eden Corp has to offer.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/2890d9cbb954a2832f245c8938c4c8c3c33de4dc.gif[/img]
[i]Oh dear. You appear to be experiencing some kind of psychedelic trip. How terribly embarrassing.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f1f37d59129ed0522c7c96fbb00d04e866cb96d1.jpg[/img]
[i]Final in-game render as you approach your final stop.[/i]

You’ve arrived at your destination: the Watson Genomics complex, where the very fabric of life itself is deconstructed, analyzed, manipulated, revamped, and reengineered down to its last molecule.

What does that mean for you? Let’s just say that robots aren’t your only enemies in this place.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/2b54331f44119ba36c1714b65951ada374087b97.gif[/img]
[i]Approaching our final destination (hopefully not literally).[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/39416a48172f506d1f55c3c17953defdf30a0aed.jpg[/img]
[i]Final in-game render of the Watson Genomics exterior.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/89c1de369aaaa4857c3d63b894e1f5759ea7bbad.gif[/img]
[i]Welcome! Would you care to step inside?[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/294ad56ff53096eb939f0b7cb2b9d066400a137b.jpg[/img]
[i]Original concepts for the Watson Genomics entrance hallway.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1fdd5b9ac6cf611de583a47d65bd7c48dea8f2fb.jpg[/img]
[i]Final in-game render of the Watson Genomics interior.[/i]

Within Watson Genomics, you’ll find a curious, calming meditation environment called the Attunement Chamber. However, you’re deep enough into Eden to know that the glossy facade and zenlike atmosphere are not all that meets the eye.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8fe4c2b2b6f51d6380e73862cf9e0d4b3dd36219.jpg[/img]
[i]Original concept art of the Attunement Chamber.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ac8edcef8368f7dd6bb4b16d3e24d0f2367a679d.jpg[/img]
[i]Final in-game render of the Attunement Chamber.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/05b7f2e99bca678fcad9aa2f9574e5da2d65b884.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/36592b03cf62461be4048b0cb460755ba5249bd5.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f1fe827fb5e20f07d72106349a85ca750edce313.gif[/img]

What does it all mean? Find out on Friday when you enter the Botanical Gardens for the first time.

[i]Tomorrow: get to know Elder’s abilities in his official hero profile![/i]

P.S. Below, check out more of the Survios art team's awesome concept art that contributed to the final design of the in-game Botanical Gardens environment.

notes.title: The Rogue Update 0.7 Coming July 14!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/177be980b58d45f75016499ec00a9ffe65fb4eac.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

After lots of anticipation, we’re stoked to announce that [i]Raw Data[/i] Update 0.7—a.k.a. The Rogue Update, our most ambitious and content-heavy update yet!—will officially drop this [b]Friday, July 14[/b], exactly a year after [i]Raw Data[/i] made its Steam Early Access debut. It’s a fitting milestone to mark, as [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/1334602669387431027]0.7 is the final Early Access update[/url] before [i]Raw Data[/i] joins the roster of finished titles later this year.

To celebrate, we’ve packed a ton of exciting content into this update that we can’t wait for everyone to play.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/29f0a9ac93f5f360fc6ca370de9dd72a85bfc091.jpg[/img]

First off, as you can tell from the name of this update, is our fourth SyndiK8 operative: Elder, the Rogue Hunter. Robin Hood doesn’t have anything on this expert archer and his nanotech-enhanced weaponry. After turning his back on a lifetime as a skilled assassin, Elder is once again taking up his bow against Eden Corporation. He has vowed to destroy the corporate demons who broke his family and drove his daughter, Saija, to undertake extreme measures to exact her own revenge. We’ll go more in-depth into Elder’s gameplay and special abilities in his upcoming Hero Profile!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/548439b141c90de156867a7a70b39b6c72dba387.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Raw Data PvP Beta OPEN to All Operatives This Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d539d7856c3e971ee12bea88a67593356c31baa9.jpg[/img]

After two awesome weekends of PvP madness, Survios is stoked to announce that this weekend's [i]Raw Data: Hostile Takeover[/i] PvP Beta is open to all SyndiK8 operatives!

[i]Dates and times mentioned in this email are subject to change at any moment.[/i]

[b]The beta build is ready to be downloaded.[/b] Although you won't be able to play just yet, you can have it preloaded so you can jump in as soon as the servers are live!

Speaking of the servers: [b]the beta test servers will go live Friday, July 7, at 12pm PT![/b] The test will then run through Saturday, July 8, 9pm PT. Here are important times to remember (all times are PT):
[list]
    [*]Friday servers go live: 12pm
    [*]Friday Play with the Devs: 3-5pm
    [*]Friday Happy Hours: 12pm, 3pm, 6pm
    [*]Saturday Happy Hours: 12pm, 3pm, 6pm
    [*]Saturday server shutdown: 9pm
[/list]
[b]STEAM INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b]

Follow the instructions below to preload the beta build on Steam.* You can download the build but will not be able to play until the servers go live on Friday at 12pm PT.
[olist]
    [*]In your Steam Library, right click [i]Raw Data[/i]​ and select PROPERTIES.
    [*]Click the BETAS​ tab at the top of the menu.
    [*]Click the dropdown, select "pvp_beta -" from the list, and click CLOSE.
    [*]Close Steam and restart to ensure that the build is updated before launching. You should see "Raw Data [pvp_beta -]" display.
    [*]Launch [i]Raw Data[/i] and have fun!
    [*]IMPORTANT: After you have finished participating in the beta, make sure to return to the Betas tab in Properties and select "NONE - opt out of all beta programs" so that you continue to receive updates for [i]Raw Data[/i].
[/olist]
[i]*[b]Oculus Home users:[/b] please email us at betatest@survios.com to receive build download instructions. Thank you![/i]

[b]IMPORTANT! PLEASE READ[/b]

Please note that this is an unfinished build, so bugs and crashes are to be expected, reported, and recorded. If you have any questions, please directly email us at betatest@survios.com.

All singleplayer and co-op content, including Profile Saves, have been disabled while playing with the Beta build to ensure that your save data does not become corrupted when switching back to the live [i]Raw Data[/i] build. Your progress will not be saved between sessions.

[b]DISCORD SERVER[/b]

To encourage active communication and participation throughout this closed beta, we’ve set up a [i]Hostile Takeover[/i] Discord server exclusively for beta testers. Here, you can chat with [i]Raw Data[/i] devs and players alike to share your thoughts and opinions in real time. Here’s how to join the Discord server:
[olist]
    [*]If you don’t already have it, install [url=http://discordapp.com]Discord[/url].
    [*]Follow this link to join the [i]Hostile Takeover[/i] server: https://discord.gg/5NsF43v
[/olist]
Thank you so much for your continued support of Survios and [i]Raw Data[/i]! Enjoy the beta.

Regards,

The [i]Raw Data[/i] development team

notes.title: State of Raw Data: Part 2 (E3 Edition)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/e9a1309d814207b81aafe3fde88f43c2b7d94205.png[/img]

Hey everyone,
 
Last year, as the [i]Raw Data[/i] team was about to begin at an extended period of crucial development, we decided to update the community on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/724346080695842247]State of [i]Raw Data[/i][/url]. Now, with E3 (and some very exciting game news) just around the corner, we thought it was a perfect time to revisit you guys and provide an update. So here we are with the State of [i]Raw Data[/i], E3 Edition!
 
[i]Raw Data[/i] and its awesome player community have been essential to Survios’ growth and development—so many of you enlisted in SyndiK8 the first week, even the first day, it hit Early Access, and you’ve all been a crucial component of its evolution since then. Your feedback has made possible not just bug fixes, but nuanced Active VR mechanics, powerful yet balanced individual heroes, ever-more-difficult mission challenges, and an engaging interwoven storyline. You guys rock and mean so much to us, and that’s why we wanted to address you directly concerning some of the additions and changes coming to [i]Raw Data[/i].  
 
So I’ll get right to it: when’s the next update? Good news, everyone! We have one huge update slated to come out this summer: Update 0.7. After Update 0.6 brought Oculus Rift+Touch compatibility and cross-platform online play to [i]Raw Data[/i], we shifted our focus back to content—a lot of it.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/29f0a9ac93f5f360fc6ca370de9dd72a85bfc091.jpg[/img]
 
Throughout this year in Early Access, we’ve sometimes had to make hard decisions regarding content priorities, but with 0.7, we’ve been able to revisit and realize several of those delayed ideas. Bringing fresh gameplay that adds a whole new level of replayability, 0.7 is arguably the most ambitious update we’ve had to date, which seems fitting considering what’s coming after. Over the next several weeks, we’re going to reveal more news and content about what’s to come in this thrilling new chapter of [i]Raw Data[/i]’s development saga. Check out the first teaser below...

https://youtu.be/JtteuTAK3PI
 
Often requested and hotly anticipated, PvP has finally come to [i]Raw Data[/i] with [i]Hostile Takeover[/i], an all-new game mode that pits optimized versions of your favorite heroes in SyndiK8 vs. Eden Corp showdowns! (We're also adding joystick locomotion as an option in 0.7 for those of you who are apprehensive about teleshifting in PvP.) If you want to be among the first to put your Bishop sharpshooter skills or Saija ninja flair to the test against your fellow operatives, sign up for our [i]Raw Data: Hostile Takeeover[/i] PvP Closed Beta Weekends this summer: [url=rawdatagame.com/hostiletakeover]RawDataGame.com/HostileTakeover[/url]
 
After Update 0.7 is [i]Raw Data[/i] V1. That’s right: the game will officially be out of Early Access and complete. We’re absolutely thrilled to bring you the conclusion to our narrative journey, but don’t worry: it doesn’t end there. We’ll still be here engaging with you all and hopefully jumping in to join you for some robot and player decimation alike!
 
We can’t wait for you to experience all of [i]Raw Data[/i]’s new content, so if you want to hear all of Survios’ E3 news straight from the source, follow us on our social media channels:
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Survios]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/surviosvr/]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://www.instagram.com/survios/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]
 
We’ll be streaming and posting LIVE from the E3 show floor, including hosting some Q&As with the dev team, so stay tuned to our channels for everything VR at E3!
 
As always, thank you so much for your continued support of Raw Data and Survios, and your ongoing passion for VR content and development.
 
Signing off,
The [i]Raw Data[/i] team

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/29f0a9ac93f5f360fc6ca370de9dd72a85bfc091.jpg[/img]
 
Throughout this year in Early Access, we’ve sometimes had to make hard decisions regarding content priorities, but with 0.7, we’ve been able to revisit and realize several of those delayed ideas. Bringing fresh gameplay that adds a whole new level of replayability, 0.7 is arguably the most ambitious update we’ve had to date, which seems fitting considering what’s coming after. Over the next several weeks, we’re going to reveal more news and content about what’s to come in this thrilling new chapter of [i]Raw Data[/i]’s development saga. Check out the first teaser below...

https://youtu.be/JtteuTAK3PI
 
Often requested and hotly anticipated, PvP has finally come to [i]Raw Data[/i] with [i]Hostile Takeover[/i], an all-new game mode that pits optimized versions of your favorite heroes in SyndiK8 vs. Eden Corp showdowns! (We're also adding joystick locomotion as an option in 0.7 for those of you who are apprehensive about teleshifting in PvP.) If you want to be among the first to put your Bishop sharpshooter skills or Saija ninja flair to the test against your fellow operatives, sign up for our [i]Raw Data: Hostile Takeeover[/i] PvP Closed Beta Weekends this summer: [url=rawdatagame.com/hostiletakeover]RawDataGame.com/HostileTakeover[/url]
 
After Update 0.7 is [i]Raw Data[/i] V1. That’s right: the game will officially be out of Early Access and complete. We’re absolutely thrilled to bring you the conclusion to our narrative journey, but don’t worry: it doesn’t end there. We’ll still be here engaging with you all and hopefully jumping in to join you for some robot and player decimation alike!
 
We can’t wait for you to experience all of [i]Raw Data[/i]’s new content, so if you want to hear all of Survios’ E3 news straight from the source, follow us on our social media channels:
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Survios]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/surviosvr/]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://www.instagram.com/survios/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]
 
We’ll be streaming and posting LIVE from the E3 show floor, including hosting some Q&As with the dev team, so stay tuned to our channels for everything VR at E3!
 
As always, thank you so much for your continued support of Raw Data and Survios, and your ongoing passion for VR content and development.
 
Signing off,
The [i]Raw Data[/i] team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.4 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
 
We've just pushed [i]Raw Data[/i] Hotfix 0.6.4 live, so be sure to update your game! This hotfix comes courtesy of information gleaned from our gameplay analytics data, which revealed that overall player progression throughout [i]Raw Data[/i]'s missions isn't, well, progressing.

Since we've added a lot of engaging new narrative content, especially in the later missions, it's become a priority for us that more players get to experience it. In this hotfix, we're making some overall tweaks to the game mechanics to ensure more players get to see each level of Eden Corp and become fully immersed in the story behind [i]Raw Data[/i]'s robot slaughter.

As always, our devs are happy to address any questions you have, and we thank you for your ongoing feedback and bug reports!

[u]Edited to add:[/u]
In response to some concerns our players have expressed about this hotfix: we can assure you that none of [i]Raw Data[/i]'s core gameplay mechanics or AI behavior have been modified. We have made some minor adjustments to player and Data Core health on Casual and Normal difficulty settings, but for those seasoned SyndiK8 operatives itching for some challenging robot carnage, Hard and Nightmare modes remain unchanged--those bots are just as brutal as ever!
As always, we hear and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for sharing it with us and for your continued support of Survios and [i]Raw Data[/i].

notes.content:

Happy Friday! To coincide with Vive's 1st anniversary and [i]Raw Data[/i]'s Free Weekend, we wanted to come up with a challenge worthy of our community. This weekend, we're looking for the fastest sharpshooter in Neo-Shinjuku.

The rules are simple: play as Bishop (or Boss if you want to prove you're the boss of [i]Raw Data[/i] gunplay) and get as many headshots as possible without dying. You can play on any level at any difficulty, single-player or co-op. We just want to see you hit those bots between their cold LED eyes.

To enter, screenshot* your best score with 0 deaths and share it on [url=http://www.twitter.com/survios]Twitter[/url] or [url=www.instagram.com/survios]Instagram[/url] with [b]@Survios[/b] and [i]#Headshots[/i] in the caption. That's it!

What's in it for you? The top shot wins a swag pack with a cool Bishop t-shirt, [i]Raw Data[/i] flash drive, and Survios hat!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/cc4fc6589ffeae027940c6dc6aed04c23808b1f3.jpg[/img]

Challenge entries close Monday, April 10, at 12 noon. Good luck; may your bullets find their marks!

[i]*Don't know how to screenshot? Here's the easiest way. Once you see the scoreboard:
[olist]
[*]Take off your HMD.
[*]Hold it up with one hand so the scoreboard is in view.
[*]With your other hand, press the Print Screen (PrtScr) button to save the screenshot.
[/olist][/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hope you've all been enjoying [i]Raw Data[/i] v0.6, especially taking out the Cataclysm generators with Saija's and Boss's new abilities! We've had some time to read through all your feedback and bug reports--as always, thank you so much for taking the time to send them our way!--and as a result we've put together a quick hotfix to address some of the most persistent issues.

[i][b]Patch Notes for Hotfix 0.6.2[/b] (released March 30, 2017)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Weapon Cooldown Indicators:[/b] Fixed an issue where cooldown indicators on the side of weapons were not displaying correctly
[*][b]Oculus Home Profile:[/b] Reset Profile should now function correctly for Oculus Home users
[*][b]Auto-Grip:[/b] Added option in Preferences to disable/enable Auto-Grip functionality for 2-handed weapons
[*][b]Stuck Cataclysm Bots:[/b] Added more refined system for detecting/fixing bots when they get stuck in some areas of Cataclysm
[/list]

Thanks so much, and keep pointing out the bugs and letting us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Play with the Devs/Q&A Stream TONIGHT at 6pm PDT!
notes.content:
UPDATE: Play with the Devs will kick off at 6pm PDT as planned, but the Twitch Dev Q&A stream won't start until 7pm due to some setup issues. Thanks so much for your support! 

To celebrate the launch of [i]Raw Data[/i] on Oculus and the 0.6 update, tonight we invite the community to join us for a Dev Q&A session and [strike]Punch Bots with the Devs[/strike]Play with the Devs session at 6pm PDT!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a7cb68300a8ff3a6652bda76c41e278517d81bf3.gif[/img]

Want to chat with [i]Raw Data[/i] devs about Oculus optimization, Boss' and Saija's new abilities, or tips for beating Cataclysm? Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/survios]our Twitch channel at 6pm PDT[/url] to hear all about the development of 0.6's features and the process of optimizing [i]Raw Data[/i]'s roomscale Active VR for Oculus' 2-camera tracking.

At the same time, a group of Survios devs will be hopping online to play co-op Cataclysm missions with community members! Pick up strategies, tips, and tricks for the new hero abilities while fending off bots from an elevator. Look for these usernames in the Showroom or on the matchmaker to team up (and there may be more joining in):
[list]
[*]Katixxia - Gabby (QA)
[*]mechanize - Chris L. (Engineer)
[*]mmassok88 - Megan (Operations)
[*]mntabo - Ray (Engineer)
[*]Survios_CS - Rico (CS)
[*]SurviosDemo05 - Lauren L. (Artist)
[*]THEPANDAGOD - Daniel Z. (Programmer)
[*]thethousandmasks - Chris D. (Producer)
[/list]
We'll continue to play with you guys after the stream ends. ːsteamhappyː Whether you opt to tune in or log on (from both Vive and Oculus now!), we hope you join us tonight at 6pm PDT! See you in the Eden Corp Showroom.

notes.title: Raw Data Update 0.6 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/abf33f307e6b64fab90196ba1a45b0a63fed9a35.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

After [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/661305015046996827]announcing last month[/url] that our next update would officially bring [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/986581138113138/]Oculus compatibility[/url] and cross-platform play to [i]Raw Data[/i], it’s finally here. (There’s also a bunch more exciting new content that we’ll get to in a second!)

Today is an awesome day for the VR community: it’s the first fulfillment of Survios’ platform-agnostic vision for social, human-facing VR, and we’re continuing to explore new and exciting ways to enhance cross-platform socialization and communication. But for now, we’re stoked to welcome Oculus players into the [i]Raw Data[/i] community and work together to unify the VR community, one robot kill at a time!

A quick note on cross-platform as it works right now: the blue avatars that appear in the Showroom will now be populated by both Oculus Home and Steam users! You can play together by using Raw Data’s multiplayer search function; [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=884364884]check out the instructions here[/url] for setting up a game. Also, while Raw Data does have cross-platform functionality, users on Oculus and Steam will not see each other on their store-specific friends list. As always, if you have any issues, check out our Steam Community forums and please submit any bugs you encounter via our [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url]!

[i]Also, Oculus users: if you already purchased the game through Steam, there's no need to re-buy on Oculus Home. We've added the Oculus optimizations to the Steam version as well, so you'll get the same experience.[/i]

And just in time, we’ve got a brand-new mission for Vive and Oculus users to play together. SyndiK8 has tasked you with a highly-classified objective—with the reassuring codename of “Cataclysm”—that’ll cripple Eden’s defense system, but as you get closer to unlocking the macabre secrets of Eden Corp, you’re getting a strange impression that it isn’t just aNg3L who’s been monitoring your progress. Chairman Shiro has a surprise for you as well.

https://youtu.be/BwBQXbFJotA

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/acc87516a507dc88eb4099fb5e1bd301924958ce.jpg[/img]

Fortunately, two of SyndiK8’s elite operatives have been putting in some lengthy training sessions. After the horrors they’ve already witnessed, Saija’s and Boss’ commitment to the cause has only grown more steadfast, and that’s reflected in their new and reworked special abilities. Here’s a quick rundown, but we recommend reading the patch notes for the full details on all the fun ways you can crush your enemies, see them driven before you, and hear the lamentations of their programming.

Boss finally got the tech to upgrade his Zaitomo bionic arms, and with them come two abilities. [b]Iron Fist[/b] charges his enhanced musculature to deliver a devastating melee knockout to any unfortunate enemy who gets too close. And when you mean business, the ultimate [b]Fury[/b] is Boss’ version of a berserker rage, complete with reduced incoming damage, a residual AOE, and lots of lots of beating in robots’ faces.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dbbc3936982e9b56162b4c35ed8fa2c1484c7a04.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3afa5131195d5540ad58277ba1a6ef2a20b00892.jpg[/img]

Through her meditative-yet-vicious [i]ninjutsu[/i] training sessions, Saija has tapped deep into the teachings she recalls from her father’s days in The Shimmering Blade and reevaluated her personal loadout. It’s a good thing she’s on our side, because when her very human feelings of hatred and betrayal merge with her skills, the results can be devastating.

As she’s become even more attuned to channeling her fury through her Flash Blade, Saija’s ditched Shuriken Stream in favor of a more two-handed approach to taking out distant enemies. Her new ability [b]Focal Strike[/b] charges the Flash Blade when readying a two-handed strike, increasing damage and extending reach when the blade meets its mark. And when she’s really angry, Saija enters a different plane altogether, one where her superhuman reaction time ensures her strikes hit home: the ultimate [b]Shadow Slash[/b] unleashes heat-seeking energy beams with every slash of her Flash Blade that directly targets distant enemies for effective, efficient cleanup.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a131368efc092211a4086a9cc8fbbf32c6e2aa88.gif[/img]

Finally, Gravity Thrust has been combined into [b]Telekinesis[/b]— this singular and more powerful move is no longer an ultimate, but a special ability activated with the Grip or Trigger buttons—to cause a lot of damage to a primary enemy while affecting those around it with an AOE.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1149e7388babd4a7aa9da91a65eff3d0a398adc4.gif[/img]

Finally, we’ve added a new unlockable deployable defense: a heavy-hitting [b]Mortar Turret[/b]. This long-range turret fires explosive shells at distant enemies, but is less accurate at targeting close-range threats, so place it wisely!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/11a576902927c321f758e006136867dd77588a8b.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to hear about your experiences with Saija’s and Boss’ new loadouts, especially if you team up on the Cataclysm mission together. ːsteamhappyː Thank you guys for being so awesome and supportive, and stay tuned to the new in-game Community Board for more [i]Raw Data[/i] news and cool community updates!

[b][i]Patch Notes for Update 0.6 (released March 16, 2017)[/i][/b]

[b]IMPORTANT: Our development resolution settings have changed internally. After updating, your graphics settings will be reset and benchmarked to your hardware; you may need to adjust your settings further. Your super sampling settings multiplier will be lower than in prior builds, but will have the same or higher quality.[/b]

[b][u]Oculus Rift+Touch Support[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cross-Platform Play:[/b] Play co-op with Steam or Oculus users regardless of hardware!
[*][b]Cross-Platform Leaderboards:[/b] Steam and Oculus users are now ranked together. [i]Please note that leaderboards will be wiped from time to time during Early Access development.[/i]
[*][b]Quick-turn and Guide Arrows:[/b] Oculus players with the Touch two-camera configuration can use quick-turn to navigate Eden Corp. Additionally, holographic guide arrows keep the player oriented toward their sensors even during intense combat. [i]Quick-turn can be disabled in the options menu.[/i]
[*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Showroom tutorials have been updated with Oculus Touch controls.
[/list]

[b][u]New Abilities: Boss[/u][/b]
New abilities have been added to Boss’s loadout. We’ve also updated some of his existing functions.
[list]
[*][b]New Ability: Iron Fist:[/b] Charge up a devastating punch in either empty hand by clenching your fist and holding it near your head or upper body. When fully charged, Boss’s fist will burst with fire and electricity; swing it at an enemy to deal increased damage and knock it back.
[*][b]New Ultimate: Fury:[/b] Go on a rampage! Fury greatly reduces incoming damage and instantly charges both of Boss’s fists, allowing you to deliver repeated, rapid-fire Iron Punches. Charge your fist again while Fury is active to deal massive damage and unleash an explosive shockwave that blasts back multiple enemies.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Nade Launcher:[/b] Launched grenades can now be manually detonated. Pull the non-dominant Trigger while the grenade is in flight to make it instantly explode.
[*][b]Updated Ultimate: Air Juggle:[/b] Air Juggle now has a 15-second cooldown (up from four) and can affect Ninja Bots.
[*][b]Shotgun Auto-Grip:[/b] Added auto-grip functionality to Dominator Shotgun to improve reloading and off-hand interaction.
[*][b]VFX/SFX Polish:[/b] Boss’s abilities have updated visual and audio effects.
[/list]

[b][u]New Abilities: Saija[/u][/b]
Several of Saija’s abilities have been overhauled or replaced to improve her combat viability and balance her with the other heroes. [i]Note: Saija currently features four tech unlocks as opposed to Bishop’s and Boss’s five.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]New Ability: Focal Strike:[/b] Use a two-handed grip held close to the body to charge a more powerful slash attack with significantly increased damage and longer reach.
[*][b]New Ultimate: Shadow Slash:[/b] Enter a hyper-focused state where every swing of your Flash Blade emits a heat-seeking arc of energy that automatically travel to distant enemies.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Telekinesis:[/b] Telekinesis gains the AOE traits of Gravity Thrust (which has been removed as a separate ability) and has been improved to affect all enemy types. Telekinesis is no longer activated with the ability selector; just aim at an enemy with your empty hand and use Grab or Trigger. The primary target can be grabbed and lifted by telekinetic force while surrounding secondary targets will also be thrust in whichever direction the player gestures. Weaker enemies can be grabbed and pulled toward the player, crushing them into a ball that can then be lobbed at other enemies for significant damage. Slamming a held enemy into the ground causes them to crater for additional damage.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Katana Throw:[/b] Throwing the Flash Blade has been adjusted and should feel much more accurate to use.
[*][b]Updated Ultimate: Levitation Smash:[/b] Levitation Smash now emits a powerful, front-facing shockwave when Saija slams down.
[*][b]Removed Abilities:[/b] Shuriken Stream and Gravity Thrust have been removed from Saija’s list of abilities and/or integrated into other existing abilities.
[*][b]Flash Blade Damage:[/b] Due to her powerful new abilities, Saija’s Flash Blade damage has been reduced.
[*][b]VFX/SFX Polish:[/b] Saija’s abilities have updated visual and audio effects.
[/list]

[b][u]New Content[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Mission: Cataclysm:[/b] Descend to new depths of terror within Eden Tower’s expansive, central Data Chamber. Fend off enemies across environments that change on each attempt while disabling generators powering Eden’s defense system. Meanwhile, Chairman Shiro has something special in store for our SyndiK8 heroes…
[*][b]New Defense: Mortar Turret:[/b] Deploy a turret that fires explosive, long-range mortars at enemies. This turret is most effective at taking out distant enemies, but is less accurate at targeting close-range threats.
[*][b]Community Board:[/b] Upon entering the Showroom after launch, players will now see a splash screen displaying information relevant to the Raw Data community, including promotions, community events, and maintenance downtime for online services.
[*][b]Shotgun Tutorial:[/b] A new product demonstration outlining Boss’s Dominator Shotgun is now available in the Showroom.
[*][b]Player Representation System:[/b] Complete overhaul to player rig and animations to more accurately reflect the player’s real-world body.
[*][b]AI Animation Polish:[/b] Various animation improvements for Rifle Bot, Beam Bot, Melee Bot, and Heavy Bot. Additionally, core AI locomotion functionality has been reworked to improve the look of all ground enemy movement.
[*][b]Orbital Rings in Title Room:[/b] Players will now see the full scope of Eden Corp’s influence in the [i]Raw Data[/i] universe from the very start of the game.
[*][b]General VFX Polish:[/b] Visual effects for heroes, defenses, and enemies have been polished throughout the game.
[*][b]Showroom AFK Detection:[/b] Added AFK detection in the Showroom to remove inactive hosts from the matchmaking queue.
[/list]

[b][u]Gameplay & Balance Improvements[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unlock System Update:[/b] Hero abilities will now be unlocked depending on which hero is used to complete a mission. The amount of stolen tech available from each mission remains unchanged, but is now tracked per hero, allowing each hero to unlock tech from earlier missions. Turrets become available for all characters as new maps are unlocked. [i]Note: players with partial unlocks as of this update may encounter issues with some unlocks. To fix this issue, reset your profile in the Options Menu.[/i]
[*][b]Player Damage Feedback System:[/b] Players will now receive visual indicators when damaged, telling them where they’re hit and by which enemy.
[*][b]Melee Combat Feedback Improvements:[/b] Improved VFX/SFX implemented for critical hits. Improved AI attack VFX, SFX, and animations to more effectively communicate attack indicators. Bot dismemberment will now trigger more frequently on weaker enemies.
[*][b]Turret Updates:[/b] Turrets now have placement limits: smaller maps allow fewer turrets to be placed, and playing co-op will further reduce the number of turrets that can be placed.
[/list]

[b][u]Performance Optimizations[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]LOD Culling:[/b] Implemented distance LOD culling on VFX to improve performance.
[*][b]Ragdoll Scaling:[/b] Implemented dynamic ragdoll lifetime scaling for improved performance. 
[*][b]Adjustable Physics:[/b] Added an Options setting for adjusting global physics that should allow users on weaker CPUs to adjust settings for better performance.
[*][b]LOD Bone Reduction:[/b] Implemented more aggressive LOD bone reduction for enemies.
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[i]AI[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Stuck Bots:[/b] Added a system to recognize when bots become stuck and automatically move them to an area where they can path to the player again.
[*][b]Bot Melee Attacks:[/b] Fixed an issue where Runner Bots and Laser Bots could not harm the player with melee attacks.
[*][b]Bot Collision:[/b] Fixed a collision volume that was being left behind after killing Melee Bots and Runner Bots.
[/list]
[i]Missions[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Death Music:[/b] Fixed various problems with music not playing after player death.
[*][b]Thundershock Terminal:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck when falling from area behind terminal in Thundershock
[*][b]Extermination Puzzle:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused handles on puzzle in Extermination to not display interaction glow properly.
[*][b]Extermination Defenses:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could respawn inside placed defenses in Extermination.
[*][b]Data Extractor:[/b] Fixed an issue where Extractor readout was not updating.
[/list]
[i]Heroes[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Fusion Shot:[/b] Fixed an issue where haptic vibration could sometimes sustain indefinitely after firing a Fusion Shot.
[*][b]Charged Shot:[/b] Fixed an issue where Bishop’s Charged Shot could penetrate the environment.
[*][b]Katana Throw:[/b] Fixed an issue with Saija’s Katana Throw behaving erratically.
[*][b]Levitation Smash:[/b] Fixed an issue where using Saija’s Levitation Smash and being killed by a melee attack would launch the player into orbit.
[/list]
[i]UI[/i]
[list]
[*][b]EULA:[/b] Fixed an issue that stole focus from the game when player is first loading into the EULA room.
[*][b]Unlock Icons:[/b] Fixed various issues with unlock icons not displaying correctly in UI.
[*][b]Steam Overlay Crash:[/b] Exiting the game via the Steam overlay UI no longer crashes the game.
[*][b]Disconnect Notification:[/b] Hosts should now properly receive a notification when clients disconnect.
[*][b]Broken Tutorials:[/b] Fixed an issue where using the Replay Intro button would break tutorials.
[/list]
[i]Multiplayer Networking[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Match Reconnection:[/b] Fixed various matchmaking and joining issues when a client disconnects and attempts to reconnect to the same host.
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Some issues with partially unlocked hero abilities conflicting with new abilities. To fix this, reset player profile through Options menu.
[*]Matchfinding Avatar Player-to-Player calling has been temporarily disabled to address connectivity issues. This feature will return in a future update.
[*]Leaderboard scores do not always immediately update after returning from a mission.
[*]Multiplayer Lobby does not always update mission info after host changes it.
[*]Switching texture quality settings in Graphics Options can sometimes cause the skydome in Showroom to display artifacts.
[*]Boss’ Iron Punch effects can trigger when interacting with UI.
[*]Boss’ Dominator Shotgun recoil is extremely high when firing during Timewarp.
[*]Boss’ Dominator Shotgun can sometimes not fully reload if the player does not push the pump all the way forward. This will be fixed in a coming update.
[*]Saija’s Telekinesis effects can trigger when interacting with UI.
[*]Using Telekinesis on Hard Point intro bot breaks the intro.
[*]Cataclysm bots sometimes walk through spawn doors on client.
[*]Unplugging a USB-connected headset will cause the game to crash/freeze.
[*]Heavy Grenade bots sometimes stop walking and pause for a few seconds before continuing. This will be resolved in a coming update.
[*]Rifle Bots sometimes teleport to cover after being attacked in Hardpoint.
[*]Bots will sometimes slide along the ground when standing up after being knocked down.
[*]No collision in elevator shaft if player walks off the edge.
[*]Cataclysm bots sometimes sink into the ground during Phase 5 elevator sequence.
[*]A noticeable performance drop occurs when player is killed.
[*]Heavy Performance drop can occur in Skybound when using Mortar Turrets.
[*]Eden Corp Orbital Rings display graphical artifacts.
[*]Bots can teleport to player positions when player is standing on top of cover in some maps.
[*]Projectiles from enemies and defenses sometimes lag on client side.
[*]Enemies targeted by Telekinesis do not always properly replicate to client players.
[/list]

Fortunately, two of SyndiK8’s elite operatives have been putting in some lengthy training sessions. After the horrors they’ve already witnessed, Saija’s and Boss’ commitment to the cause has only grown more steadfast, and that’s reflected in their new and reworked special abilities. Here’s a quick rundown, but we recommend reading the patch notes for the full details on all the fun ways you can crush your enemies, see them driven before you, and hear the lamentations of their programming.

Boss finally got the tech to upgrade his Zaitomo bionic arms, and with them come two abilities. [b]Iron Fist[/b] charges his enhanced musculature to deliver a devastating melee knockout to any unfortunate enemy who gets too close. And when you mean business, the ultimate [b]Fury[/b] is Boss’ version of a berserker rage, complete with reduced incoming damage, a residual AOE, and lots of lots of beating in robots’ faces.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dbbc3936982e9b56162b4c35ed8fa2c1484c7a04.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3afa5131195d5540ad58277ba1a6ef2a20b00892.jpg[/img]

Through her meditative-yet-vicious [i]ninjutsu[/i] training sessions, Saija has tapped deep into the teachings she recalls from her father’s days in The Shimmering Blade and reevaluated her personal loadout. It’s a good thing she’s on our side, because when her very human feelings of hatred and betrayal merge with her skills, the results can be devastating.

As she’s become even more attuned to channeling her fury through her Flash Blade, Saija’s ditched Shuriken Stream in favor of a more two-handed approach to taking out distant enemies. Her new ability [b]Focal Strike[/b] charges the Flash Blade when readying a two-handed strike, increasing damage and extending reach when the blade meets its mark. And when she’s really angry, Saija enters a different plane altogether, one where her superhuman reaction time ensures her strikes hit home: the ultimate [b]Shadow Slash[/b] unleashes heat-seeking energy beams with every slash of her Flash Blade that directly targets distant enemies for effective, efficient cleanup.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a131368efc092211a4086a9cc8fbbf32c6e2aa88.gif[/img]

Finally, Gravity Thrust has been combined into [b]Telekinesis[/b]— this singular and more powerful move is no longer an ultimate, but a special ability activated with the Grip or Trigger buttons—to cause a lot of damage to a primary enemy while affecting those around it with an AOE.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1149e7388babd4a7aa9da91a65eff3d0a398adc4.gif[/img]

Finally, we’ve added a new unlockable deployable defense: a heavy-hitting [b]Mortar Turret[/b]. This long-range turret fires explosive shells at distant enemies, but is less accurate at targeting close-range threats, so place it wisely!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/11a576902927c321f758e006136867dd77588a8b.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to hear about your experiences with Saija’s and Boss’ new loadouts, especially if you team up on the Cataclysm mission together. ːsteamhappyː Thank you guys for being so awesome and supportive, and stay tuned to the new in-game Community Board for more [i]Raw Data[/i] news and cool community updates!

[b][i]Patch Notes for Update 0.6 (released March 16, 2017)[/i][/b]

[b]IMPORTANT: Our development resolution settings have changed internally. After updating, your graphics settings will be reset and benchmarked to your hardware; you may need to adjust your settings further. Your super sampling settings multiplier will be lower than in prior builds, but will have the same or higher quality.[/b]

[b][u]Oculus Rift+Touch Support[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cross-Platform Play:[/b] Play co-op with Steam or Oculus users regardless of hardware!
[*][b]Cross-Platform Leaderboards:[/b] Steam and Oculus users are now ranked together. [i]Please note that leaderboards will be wiped from time to time during Early Access development.[/i]
[*][b]Quick-turn and Guide Arrows:[/b] Oculus players with the Touch two-camera configuration can use quick-turn to navigate Eden Corp. Additionally, holographic guide arrows keep the player oriented toward their sensors even during intense combat. [i]Quick-turn can be disabled in the options menu.[/i]
[*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Showroom tutorials have been updated with Oculus Touch controls.
[/list]

[b][u]New Abilities: Boss[/u][/b]
New abilities have been added to Boss’s loadout. We’ve also updated some of his existing functions.
[list]
[*][b]New Ability: Iron Fist:[/b] Charge up a devastating punch in either empty hand by clenching your fist and holding it near your head or upper body. When fully charged, Boss’s fist will burst with fire and electricity; swing it at an enemy to deal increased damage and knock it back.
[*][b]New Ultimate: Fury:[/b] Go on a rampage! Fury greatly reduces incoming damage and instantly charges both of Boss’s fists, allowing you to deliver repeated, rapid-fire Iron Punches. Charge your fist again while Fury is active to deal massive damage and unleash an explosive shockwave that blasts back multiple enemies.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Nade Launcher:[/b] Launched grenades can now be manually detonated. Pull the non-dominant Trigger while the grenade is in flight to make it instantly explode.
[*][b]Updated Ultimate: Air Juggle:[/b] Air Juggle now has a 15-second cooldown (up from four) and can affect Ninja Bots.
[*][b]Shotgun Auto-Grip:[/b] Added auto-grip functionality to Dominator Shotgun to improve reloading and off-hand interaction.
[*][b]VFX/SFX Polish:[/b] Boss’s abilities have updated visual and audio effects.
[/list]

[b][u]New Abilities: Saija[/u][/b]
Several of Saija’s abilities have been overhauled or replaced to improve her combat viability and balance her with the other heroes. [i]Note: Saija currently features four tech unlocks as opposed to Bishop’s and Boss’s five.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]New Ability: Focal Strike:[/b] Use a two-handed grip held close to the body to charge a more powerful slash attack with significantly increased damage and longer reach.
[*][b]New Ultimate: Shadow Slash:[/b] Enter a hyper-focused state where every swing of your Flash Blade emits a heat-seeking arc of energy that automatically travel to distant enemies.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Telekinesis:[/b] Telekinesis gains the AOE traits of Gravity Thrust (which has been removed as a separate ability) and has been improved to affect all enemy types. Telekinesis is no longer activated with the ability selector; just aim at an enemy with your empty hand and use Grab or Trigger. The primary target can be grabbed and lifted by telekinetic force while surrounding secondary targets will also be thrust in whichever direction the player gestures. Weaker enemies can be grabbed and pulled toward the player, crushing them into a ball that can then be lobbed at other enemies for significant damage. Slamming a held enemy into the ground causes them to crater for additional damage.
[*][b]Updated Ability: Katana Throw:[/b] Throwing the Flash Blade has been adjusted and should feel much more accurate to use.
[*][b]Updated Ultimate: Levitation Smash:[/b] Levitation Smash now emits a powerful, front-facing shockwave when Saija slams down.
[*][b]Removed Abilities:[/b] Shuriken Stream and Gravity Thrust have been removed from Saija’s list of abilities and/or integrated into other existing abilities.
[*][b]Flash Blade Damage:[/b] Due to her powerful new abilities, Saija’s Flash Blade damage has been reduced.
[*][b]VFX/SFX Polish:[/b] Saija’s abilities have updated visual and audio effects.
[/list]

[b][u]New Content[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Mission: Cataclysm:[/b] Descend to new depths of terror within Eden Tower’s expansive, central Data Chamber. Fend off enemies across environments that change on each attempt while disabling generators powering Eden’s defense system. Meanwhile, Chairman Shiro has something special in store for our SyndiK8 heroes…
[*][b]New Defense: Mortar Turret:[/b] Deploy a turret that fires explosive, long-range mortars at enemies. This turret is most effective at taking out distant enemies, but is less accurate at targeting close-range threats.
[*][b]Community Board:[/b] Upon entering the Showroom after launch, players will now see a splash screen displaying information relevant to the Raw Data community, including promotions, community events, and maintenance downtime for online services.
[*][b]Shotgun Tutorial:[/b] A new product demonstration outlining Boss’s Dominator Shotgun is now available in the Showroom.
[*][b]Player Representation System:[/b] Complete overhaul to player rig and animations to more accurately reflect the player’s real-world body.
[*][b]AI Animation Polish:[/b] Various animation improvements for Rifle Bot, Beam Bot, Melee Bot, and Heavy Bot. Additionally, core AI locomotion functionality has been reworked to improve the look of all ground enemy movement.
[*][b]Orbital Rings in Title Room:[/b] Players will now see the full scope of Eden Corp’s influence in the [i]Raw Data[/i] universe from the very start of the game.
[*][b]General VFX Polish:[/b] Visual effects for heroes, defenses, and enemies have been polished throughout the game.
[*][b]Showroom AFK Detection:[/b] Added AFK detection in the Showroom to remove inactive hosts from the matchmaking queue.
[/list]

[b][u]Gameplay & Balance Improvements[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unlock System Update:[/b] Hero abilities will now be unlocked depending on which hero is used to complete a mission. The amount of stolen tech available from each mission remains unchanged, but is now tracked per hero, allowing each hero to unlock tech from earlier missions. Turrets become available for all characters as new maps are unlocked. [i]Note: players with partial unlocks as of this update may encounter issues with some unlocks. To fix this issue, reset your profile in the Options Menu.[/i]
[*][b]Player Damage Feedback System:[/b] Players will now receive visual indicators when damaged, telling them where they’re hit and by which enemy.
[*][b]Melee Combat Feedback Improvements:[/b] Improved VFX/SFX implemented for critical hits. Improved AI attack VFX, SFX, and animations to more effectively communicate attack indicators. Bot dismemberment will now trigger more frequently on weaker enemies.
[*][b]Turret Updates:[/b] Turrets now have placement limits: smaller maps allow fewer turrets to be placed, and playing co-op will further reduce the number of turrets that can be placed.
[/list]

[b][u]Performance Optimizations[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]LOD Culling:[/b] Implemented distance LOD culling on VFX to improve performance.
[*][b]Ragdoll Scaling:[/b] Implemented dynamic ragdoll lifetime scaling for improved performance. 
[*][b]Adjustable Physics:[/b] Added an Options setting for adjusting global physics that should allow users on weaker CPUs to adjust settings for better performance.
[*][b]LOD Bone Reduction:[/b] Implemented more aggressive LOD bone reduction for enemies.
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[i]AI[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Stuck Bots:[/b] Added a system to recognize when bots become stuck and automatically move them to an area where they can path to the player again.
[*][b]Bot Melee Attacks:[/b] Fixed an issue where Runner Bots and Laser Bots could not harm the player with melee attacks.
[*][b]Bot Collision:[/b] Fixed a collision volume that was being left behind after killing Melee Bots and Runner Bots.
[/list]
[i]Missions[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Death Music:[/b] Fixed various problems with music not playing after player death.
[*][b]Thundershock Terminal:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck when falling from area behind terminal in Thundershock
[*][b]Extermination Puzzle:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused handles on puzzle in Extermination to not display interaction glow properly.
[*][b]Extermination Defenses:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could respawn inside placed defenses in Extermination.
[*][b]Data Extractor:[/b] Fixed an issue where Extractor readout was not updating.
[/list]
[i]Heroes[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Fusion Shot:[/b] Fixed an issue where haptic vibration could sometimes sustain indefinitely after firing a Fusion Shot.
[*][b]Charged Shot:[/b] Fixed an issue where Bishop’s Charged Shot could penetrate the environment.
[*][b]Katana Throw:[/b] Fixed an issue with Saija’s Katana Throw behaving erratically.
[*][b]Levitation Smash:[/b] Fixed an issue where using Saija’s Levitation Smash and being killed by a melee attack would launch the player into orbit.
[/list]
[i]UI[/i]
[list]
[*][b]EULA:[/b] Fixed an issue that stole focus from the game when player is first loading into the EULA room.
[*][b]Unlock Icons:[/b] Fixed various issues with unlock icons not displaying correctly in UI.
[*][b]Steam Overlay Crash:[/b] Exiting the game via the Steam overlay UI no longer crashes the game.
[*][b]Disconnect Notification:[/b] Hosts should now properly receive a notification when clients disconnect.
[*][b]Broken Tutorials:[/b] Fixed an issue where using the Replay Intro button would break tutorials.
[/list]
[i]Multiplayer Networking[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Match Reconnection:[/b] Fixed various matchmaking and joining issues when a client disconnects and attempts to reconnect to the same host.
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Some issues with partially unlocked hero abilities conflicting with new abilities. To fix this, reset player profile through Options menu.
[*]Matchfinding Avatar Player-to-Player calling has been temporarily disabled to address connectivity issues. This feature will return in a future update.
[*]Leaderboard scores do not always immediately update after returning from a mission.
[*]Multiplayer Lobby does not always update mission info after host changes it.
[*]Switching texture quality settings in Graphics Options can sometimes cause the skydome in Showroom to display artifacts.
[*]Boss’ Iron Punch effects can trigger when interacting with UI.
[*]Boss’ Dominator Shotgun recoil is extremely high when firing during Timewarp.
[*]Boss’ Dominator Shotgun can sometimes not fully reload if the player does not push the pump all the way forward. This will be fixed in a coming update.
[*]Saija’s Telekinesis effects can trigger when interacting with UI.
[*]Using Telekinesis on Hard Point intro bot breaks the intro.
[*]Cataclysm bots sometimes walk through spawn doors on client.
[*]Unplugging a USB-connected headset will cause the game to crash/freeze.
[*]Heavy Grenade bots sometimes stop walking and pause for a few seconds before continuing. This will be resolved in a coming update.
[*]Rifle Bots sometimes teleport to cover after being attacked in Hardpoint.
[*]Bots will sometimes slide along the ground when standing up after being knocked down.
[*]No collision in elevator shaft if player walks off the edge.
[*]Cataclysm bots sometimes sink into the ground during Phase 5 elevator sequence.
[*]A noticeable performance drop occurs when player is killed.
[*]Heavy Performance drop can occur in Skybound when using Mortar Turrets.
[*]Eden Corp Orbital Rings display graphical artifacts.
[*]Bots can teleport to player positions when player is standing on top of cover in some maps.
[*]Projectiles from enemies and defenses sometimes lag on client side.
[*]Enemies targeted by Telekinesis do not always properly replicate to client players.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome Oculus Gamers!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/2cda77d7c35617062818d00e6bcfd24a973ef864.png[/img]

Hi all!

James here, writing from San Francisco as we get ready for the first day of Game Developers Conference (GDC) 2017! Hard to believe that it’s only been a year since we demoed an Alpha-state incarnation of [i]Raw Data[/i] at GDC 2016, where it got its first major mainstream press coverage and won the [i]Tom’s Guide[/i] “Best VR Game” accolade. GDC is a very important show for us, and this year, it’s even better because our [i]Raw Data[/i] focus is all about you, the community.

That’s because it’s about to get a lot bigger. Today you’ll see some news of the upcoming Update 0.6, set to launch next month. Along with a lot of amazing new content--a Saija ability rework, new Boss abilities, and a devastating new Data Chamber mission--we’re also launching the official Oculus Touch build of [i]Raw Data[/i] on Oculus Home.

This is not simply a port--we have completely reengineered and optimized the [i]Raw Data[/i] experience specifically for Oculus Touch, including support for two-camera 180° tracking for gamers with limited-size playspaces, plus three-camera mode.

Along with that, [i]Raw Data[/i] will gain cross-platform functionality, allowing Vive users on Steam to play and socialize with Oculus Home users. Cross-platform has been an important goal for Survios since the beginning because we believe that VR must be a platform-agnostic social experience, and we’re stoked to be able to bring two badass platform communities together to murder tons of evil robots.

I’m thrilled to personally welcome Oculus gamers into the [i]Raw Data[/i] community. You guys are amazing, and we can’t wait to grow together with you. Stay tuned for lots more exciting content to come on both sides of the headset!

Sincerely,
James & Survios team

P.S. There’s more awesome Survios news coming tomorrow that we’re so excited to announce, we’re getting an adrenaline rush. ;) If you’re interested, tune in to the [url=http://radeon.com/en-us/gdc-2017/]AMD keynote livestream tomorrow at 10:30am PST[/url].

notes.title: Update 0.6 Closed Beta Invites
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As we teased on Wednesday, we've got some cool new content coming in [i]Raw Data[/i]. And for the first time since Early Access launch, we're inviting our player community to get a sneak peek of what we've been working on while also helping us out!

Next weekend, we're launching a closed beta test for the upcoming [i]Raw Data[/i] Update 0.6, and we need you to jump in, play as much as you can, and share your feedback with us. Please keep in mind that this will be a beta build, which means that bugs, crashes, and other performance issues are to be expected.

**UPDATE: The registration period is now closed.  Thanks for all your support!**

Regards,
The [i]Raw Data[/i] dev team

notes.title: Twitch Thursdays start tonight at 6pm PT!
notes.content:

notes.title: #FreeKeyFriday: Raw Data x HoloBall
notes.content:
Happy Friday the 13th! And if that's not enough, it's also the first [b]#FreeKeyFriday[/b] of 2017! ːsteamhappyː 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/03e95ae137e11c8423c477a70abac2c684c09092.jpg[/img]

This month, we've resolved to help you keep your resolution: we're teaming with Tree Fortress for a two-week sweatfest featuring [i]Raw Data[/i] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/457320/][i]HoloBall[/i][/url], their awesomely fun, [i]Tron[/i]-like take on racquetball (it's also currently on sale for 50% off)!

At stake: 5 free keys for [i]Raw Data[/i], chosen randomly!

Here's how to enter the first phase of this month's challenge: 
[olist]
[*]Play [i]HoloBall[/i]’s Arcade "Score Attack" mode.
[*]Beat [b]Survios' score of 13,090[/b] and take a screenshot of your score.
[*][url=http://www.twitter.com/]Tweet[/url] your screenshot to [url=https://twitter.com/Survios][b]@Survios[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/tree_fortress][b]@Tree_Fortress[/b][/url] and tag it with [b]#FreeKeyFriday[/b].
[/olist]

The contest deadline is Monday, January 16, at 11:59pm (PT). (We're giving you a few extra hours because it's a holiday!) We'll randomly choose and announce the winners on Tuesday, January 17.

GLHF, and we hope you enjoy burning off a few calories while you're at it!

Next week, we're turning the Tree Fortress crew loose in Eden Corp to see how they handle evil robots. Stay tuned...

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.3 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Happy new year! Time for the first hotfix of 2017. ːsteamhappyː Thanks to your ongoing feedback, we've put together some fixes that address several crash-causing issues.

[b][i]Patch Notes for Hotfix 0.5.3[/i][/b] [i](Released January 5):[/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed broken save state where the user always spawns in a dark Showroom at the entrance with the Data Core and is unable to proceed in the game any further
[*]Fixed the Teleshift and other tutorial widgets appearing abnormally large on user’s hands and obstructing their view
[*]Fixed notification widget line lagging a frame behind
[*]Tutorial hint widgets that appear on user’s hands now respect the players’ handedness setting
[*]Fixed the right training session kiosk (weapon demonstration station) breaking after manually replaying the Showroom intro
[*]Bishop’s secondary holster is no longer visible when the player is left-handed and has not yet purchased the Dual Wield upgrade
[*]Fixed issue where Saija could not be knocked back
[*]Fixed issue where the game would not properly close after exiting from within SteamVR
[*]Fixed various crashes when closing the game
[*]Fixed rare crash when shooting off an AI limb
[*]Fixed crash that sometimes occur when you invite friends using the in game menu. An error will now popup in VR telling you that the invite failed.
[/list]
Please continue to share your input here on the forums and via our official [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/feedback/]Feedback Form[/url] and [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url]. Thanks again!

Hey everyone!

'Tis the season to spend time with your friends and family. What better way to liven up your holiday gathering than by seeing if they can handle the intensity of [i]Raw Data[/i]?! Maybe Grandma's a secret gunslinger, or your nephew has serious ninja skills--but if you get footage of their [b]#RawDataReaction[/b], you could win!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f13eeba850ba9a622d640c6e114b45ac025a8ea9.jpg[/img]

Share a video of a friend's or family member's #RawDataReaction for a chance to win one of three deluxe Survios/Raw Data prize packs:
[list]
[*][i]Raw Data[/i] game key
[*]Custom [i]Raw Data[/i] HTC Vive controller charging station
[*]Hoodie
[*]T-shirt
[*]Flash drive
[*]Mousepad
[*]Notebook
[*]Stickers
[*]Pens
[/list]

[olist]
[*]Ask someone you know (friends, relatives, SOs) to play [i]Raw Data[/i] for the first time—the more dramatic, energetic, or even scared they are, the better!

Or, to enter using your email, visit [b]bit.ly / RawDataReactionForm[/b] (paste into browser and remove spaces) and fill out the entry form.

notes.title: Raw Data Update 0.5 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6b2367060d9d2b6cae621a035acb1523c28a311c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

One month ago (to the day!), we shared [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/724346080695842247]a community update on the state of [i]Raw Data[/i][/url], in which we explained that Update 0.5 was going to be all about performance optimization to deliver the best possible game experience for everyone. Now that 0.5 is officially live, you can see in our extensive patch notes below that we’ve been laser-focused on polishing the [i]Raw Data[/i] experience.

For that, we have you guys to thank for continually providing us with the feedback that helps us identify and snuff out these immersion-killing issues. We’ve spent considerable time optimizing the game across multiple common system configurations, and much of this was made possible because of the performance logs provided to us by you, our community, via our profiling builds. These logs helped us to uncover many issues that we had previously been unable to reproduce in-house, and we ask that you please continue to help us refine and improve [i]Raw Data[/i] with your bug reports and performance profiling logs. For more info on how you can help, check out our Steam Community forums, and please submit any bugs you encounter via our [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url]!

However, 0.5 is not all under the hood technical fixes--we’ve got some fun stuff in store for you on the story and music side of things. If you want to speculate on the true nature of the mission behind your infiltration, check out the missions from the beginning to catch insights in the form of new storytelling elements, including environmental additions and fresh voiceover dialogue.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/68a92714082d354069929659d2891510d09f1379.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/aae0f1ce7e9b285968eb48d37f3c49e3def64cb9.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b962f888c2ece5dd6a1092c7fe558daec25ff71b.jpg[/img]

And for those of you whose heart starts racing at the first notes of Raw Data’s original score (by the very talented Jeremy Tisser), there are two new music soundtracks to be experienced in all Skyport and Data Chamber missions that are sure to quicken your pulse as you prepare for serious robot carnage.

Thank you guys for being so awesome and supportive. Enjoy the last big [i]Raw Data[/i] update of 2016, and we’ll see you next year with a lot more exciting content to come!


[b][i]Patch Notes for Update 0.5 (released December 15, 2016)[/i][/b]

[b]IMPORTANT: Our development resolution settings have changed internally. After updating, your graphics settings will be reset and benchmarked to your hardware; you may need to adjust your settings further. Your super sampling settings multiplier will be lower than in prior builds, but will have the same or higher quality.[/b]

[i]Narrative Updates[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Storytelling[/b] - Narrative VO and environmental storytelling elements added to all existing missions.
[*][b]Post-Mission[/b] - Narrative VO added to Showroom post-mission completion.
[*][b]Soundtrack[/b] - New music soundtrack added to Skybound, Vapor Exploit, Nuke Fusion, and Thundershock missions.
[*][b]Showroom Music[/b] - We have also added a calming collection of Chopin's Nocturnes to the Showroom tutorials and combat configs. These classical piano pieces are sure to keep you relaxed and focused while perusing Eden Corp's refined arsenal.
[*][b]Music Cues[/b] - New music cues implemented for player death, fail, and win states.
[*][b]Visuals[/b] - Eden Corp Orbital Connectors, Orbital Rings, and updated Skybox added to Skybound, Vapor Exploit, Thundershock, and Showroom vistas.
[/list]

[i]New Content[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Boss Unlocked[/b] - Boss is now unlocked by default. Boss’s ability upgrades will still need to be unlocked.
[*][b]Vapor Exploit Dropships[/b] - In the Vapor Exploit mission, enemies will now spawn randomly throughout the map from incoming Eden Corp Security Deployment Dropships.
[*][b]Extermination Switch Puzzle[/b] - In the Extermination mission, the Switch Puzzle now scales with difficulty and multiplayer. Switch colors can also be adjusted to support visibility for colorblind players.
[*][b]Sound Effects[/b] - We’re in the process of updating many of the game’s legacy sound effects; quite a few have already been replaced, and there’s more to come!
[/list]

[i]New Functionality[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Single-Player Pause[/b] - Players can now pause the game in single-player! Open the in-game menu and select “Pause”; to resume gameplay, make sure you’re standing in the correct position (marked by footprints on the ground) and select “Resume.”
[*][b]Improved Hand Positioning[/b] - Greatly improved the accuracy of the rendered position of player’s virtual hands and held objects in relation to their real-life hands and controllers.
[*][b]Improved Teleshift Targeting[/b] - Teleshift beam will now arc towards the actual target location to clarify where players will end up when the straight beam does not actually point at the target location (such as towards max teleport location or at a wall).
[*][b]Preferences Tab[/b] - Players can now set the following options in the Preferences panel accessed within the Main Menu and In-Game Menu: Show/Hide Forearms, Show/Hide Playspace, Enable/Disable Late Update (experimental feature to improve hand tracking latency and performance that is disabled by default).
[*][b]Global Audio Balance Pass[/b] - Rebalanced all game audio to improve audio fidelity and level out volume more. Now, when you switch from a movie, music, or other game into [i]Raw Data[/i], the volume levels will be more consistent. (Note: if you had previously lowered [i]Raw Data[/i]’s volume in the Windows Volume Mixer, we recommend turning it back up now. We’ve also reset the in-game volume options to their defaults because of these changes.)
[*][b]Unreal Engine[/b] - [i]Raw Data[/i] is now built on Unreal Engine 4.13.2 with Survios customizations.
[/list]

[i]Gameplay and Balance Improvements[/i]
[b]Bishop[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Charged Shot[/b] - Charged Shot no longer pierces the environment, and its maximum collision radius has been reduced from 30 to 25. Charged Shot collision now ramps up over time.
[*][b]Time Warp[/b] - Time Warp duration reduced to 6 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Saija[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Flash Blade[/b] - Melee damage doubled.
[*][b]Katana Throw[/b] - Katana Throw return damaged increased by 6x so it now deals the same damage throughout the entire flight.
[*][b]Levitation Smash[/b] - Levitation Smash damage increased 6x. Cooldown increased by 10 seconds.
[*][b]Reflection Counter[/b] - Reflection Counter is now a base ability; you can now reflect projectiles without needing to forcibly strike them. The collision radius has been reduced, so it will require more precise positioning of the Flash Blade to reflect projectiles, but accuracy as a whole has been increased. Using the Flash Blade with two hands still increases reflection radius and damage.
[/list]
[b]Boss[/b]
[*][b]Dominator Shotgun[/b] - Spread pattern of Dominator Shotgun has been decreased and damage falloff reduced; together, these increase its effective combat range.
[*][b]Plasma Grenade[/b] - Plasma Grenade max damage reduced and damage falloff greatly reduced. Plasma Grenade is now an effective AoE weapon, rather than a single target destroyer.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hornet Drone[/b] - Hornet Drone’s collision sphere size increased.
[*][b]Enemy Spawn[/b] - Global enemy spawn tuning.
[*][b]Enemy Animations[/b] - General improvements to enemies’ physical animation.  Ragdolls during death are now blended with animation to create a more realistic effect.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Nuke Fusion[/b] - Overall difficulty reduced and Fusion Chamber capture mechanic simplified. When captured, a Mega Dynamo will drop in as before, but Eden forces no longer retain control of the Fusion chamber after the phase ends. Enemies should no longer teleshift into the Fusion Chambers after it has been captured. Instead, enemies will need to recapture the Fusion Chamber to call in more Mega Dynamos.
[*][b]Nanos[/b] - Dealing damage no longer awards nanos--only kills do.
[/list]

[i]Performance and Stability[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Physics[/b] - Mask physics stalls during heavy scenes by moving calculations to run alongside physics in parallel where possible.
[*][b]AI Capsules[/b] - Improvements to AI capsule overlaps.
[*][b]Turrets[/b] - Improvements to turrets.
[*][b]Spawning - Reduced spawning of hit and impact effects for over-time damage abilities
[*][b]Extermination Lasers[/b] - Improvements to lasers in Extermination mission
[*][b]Crusader Pistol[/b] - Improved spawning hit of Crusader Pistol’s projectiles.
[*][b]Net Update[/b] - Reduced Net update frequency for Actors across the board. This will decrease CPU load on the host.
[*][b]Animation[/b] - General improvements to AI animation performance.
[*][b]Dynamic Assets[/b] - Optimized memory footprint by dynamically loading assets only when needed and decreasing resolution of unnecessarily high resolution textures.
[*][b]Cubemap Reflections[/b] - Lowered graphics settings use a predetermined cubemap rather than cubemap reflections to avoid a minimal visual fidelity cost.
[/list]

[i]Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Host Crash[/b] - Fixed a bug that could cause the host to crash when a client player dies.
[*][b]Shotgun Physics[/b] - Fixed the physics on Boss’s Dominator Shotgun behaving erratically after being thrown.
[*][b]Air Juggle[/b] - Fixed an issue where Boss’s Air Juggle ability would not deactivate on holster after activation
[*][b]Server List[/b] - Fixed the server list browser not updating and displaying results. Also fixed the auto-search checkbox not displaying its state properly.
[*][b]Elevator Pause[/b] - Fixed long pause before elevator descent in Dark Source and Extermination missions.
[*][b]Lost “Sticky” Pistol[/b] - Fixed an issue where player randomly loses Crusader Pistol while playing on “Sticky” control scheme.
[*][b]Sticky Weapon Drop[/b] - Fixed an issue where players could sometimes drop their weapon despite being in Sticky mode.
[*][b]VIP Bots[/b] - Fixed an issue where VIP bots were unable to capture the Fusion Chamber in Nuke Fusion mission.
[*][b]Playspace[/b] - Fixed an issue where players standing outside their playspace on launch would end up in an unresponsive state.
[*][b]Bishop Charging VFX[/b] - Fixed an issue where clients playing Bishop could sometimes break the charging VFX on Charged Shot.
[*][b]Hovering Enemies[/b] - Fixed an issue where enemy bots could sometimes hover in the air at strange angles.
[*][b]Showroom Sunken Floor[/b] - Fixed an issue where players were sometimes sunken into the floor when returning to the Showroom.
[*][b]Showroom Freeze Fix[/b] - Fixed an issue where game could lock up and freeze in the Showroom.
[*][b]Client Player Spawn[/b] - Fixed client player spawning inside the elevator when going back up from a mission into Showroom.
[*][b]Host Start[/b] - Fixed a bug that could resort in the host not being able to start a mission after playing a mission with a client and returning back to Showroom.
[*][b]Dark Source Stuck Player[/b] - Fixed an issue where players can become stuck and unable to Teleshift in spawn halls on Dark Source mission after being knocked back from an explosion.
[*][b]Extermination Lasers[/b] - Fixed an issue where lasers would not properly display on client in Extermination mission.
[*][b]Extermination Freeze[/b] - Fixed an issue where the game could lock up and freeze in Extermination mission.
[*][b]Extractor Tooltip[/b] - Fixed an issue with the Extractor tooltip not displaying properly on some maps.
[*][b]Scroll[/b] - Fixed an issue where Developer Notes would not scroll.
[*][b]Private Listing[/b] - Fixed an issue that caused some private games to be listed publicly.
[*][b]Lighting[/b] - Fixed an issue that caused some lighting to display incorrectly when the player turned their head.
[*][b]Host Game[/b] - Fix for not being able to host a game after playing the defense placement training session due to a dummy player appearing in the player list.
[*][b]Saija Ability Meter[/b] - Fixed Saija’s ability meter icon getting stuck on Shuriken Stream or Gravity Thrust.
[*][b]Rack Up Scoreboard[/b] - Fixed rack up scoreboard appearing in the Showroom when a client joins a host who had the scoreboard show up earlier.
[/list]

[i]Known Issues[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Loading Screen[/b] - Loading screen is missing and some loads may take longer than normal as asynchronous loading has been disabled. This will be fixed in a future update.
[*][b]Enemy Physics[/b] - Enemy bodies sometimes behave erratically during hit reactions, especially when impacting with other geometry. This will be addressed in a future update.
[*][b]AI Elevation[/b] - Enemies will sometimes attempt to unsuccessfully target players on higher elevation. This will be addressed in a future update.
[*][b]Stuck Heavy Rocket Bot[/b] - Heavy rocket bots will sometimes stop walking.
[*][b]Disappearing Heavy Bots[/b] - Heavy bots sometimes disappear when killed.
[*][b]Ninja Bot Targeting[/b] - Ninja bots sometimes improperly target the Data Core.
[*][b]Turret Rotation[/b] - Turret’s rotation is jerky on client machines.
[*][b]Ammo Indicator[/b] - Boss’s ammo indicator animation can become unreliable.
[*][b]Floating Turrets[/b] - Placing Turrets or the Shield Station on an elevator will cause them to float in the air.
[*][b]Bluetooth Headsets[/b] - When playing with a Bluetooth headset that has a built-in mic, audio may not be routed through the headset. Current workarounds include disabling/uninstalling headset so audio is routed to HMD, or changing Steam VR settings to force audio to be routed to headset.
