notes.title: Raw Data Update 0.5 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6b2367060d9d2b6cae621a035acb1523c28a311c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

One month ago (to the day!), we shared [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/724346080695842247]a community update on the state of [i]Raw Data[/i][/url], in which we explained that Update 0.5 was going to be all about performance optimization to deliver the best possible game experience for everyone. Now that 0.5 is officially live, you can see in our extensive patch notes below that we’ve been laser-focused on polishing the [i]Raw Data[/i] experience.

For that, we have you guys to thank for continually providing us with the feedback that helps us identify and snuff out these immersion-killing issues. We’ve spent considerable time optimizing the game across multiple common system configurations, and much of this was made possible because of the performance logs provided to us by you, our community, via our profiling builds. These logs helped us to uncover many issues that we had previously been unable to reproduce in-house, and we ask that you please continue to help us refine and improve [i]Raw Data[/i] with your bug reports and performance profiling logs. For more info on how you can help, check out our Steam Community forums, and please submit any bugs you encounter via our [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url]!

However, 0.5 is not all under the hood technical fixes--we’ve got some fun stuff in store for you on the story and music side of things. If you want to speculate on the true nature of the mission behind your infiltration, check out the missions from the beginning to catch insights in the form of new storytelling elements, including environmental additions and fresh voiceover dialogue.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/68a92714082d354069929659d2891510d09f1379.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/aae0f1ce7e9b285968eb48d37f3c49e3def64cb9.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b962f888c2ece5dd6a1092c7fe558daec25ff71b.jpg[/img]

And for those of you whose heart starts racing at the first notes of Raw Data’s original score (by the very talented Jeremy Tisser), there are two new music soundtracks to be experienced in all Skyport and Data Chamber missions that are sure to quicken your pulse as you prepare for serious robot carnage.

Thank you guys for being so awesome and supportive. Enjoy the last big [i]Raw Data[/i] update of 2016, and we’ll see you next year with a lot more exciting content to come!


[b][i]Patch Notes for Update 0.5 (released December 15, 2016)[/i][/b]

[b]IMPORTANT: Our development resolution settings have changed internally. After updating, your graphics settings will be reset and benchmarked to your hardware; you may need to adjust your settings further. Your super sampling settings multiplier will be lower than in prior builds, but will have the same or higher quality.[/b]

[i]Narrative Updates[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Storytelling[/b] - Narrative VO and environmental storytelling elements added to all existing missions.
[*][b]Post-Mission[/b] - Narrative VO added to Showroom post-mission completion.
[*][b]Soundtrack[/b] - New music soundtrack added to Skybound, Vapor Exploit, Nuke Fusion, and Thundershock missions.
[*][b]Showroom Music[/b] - We have also added a calming collection of Chopin's Nocturnes to the Showroom tutorials and combat configs. These classical piano pieces are sure to keep you relaxed and focused while perusing Eden Corp's refined arsenal.
[*][b]Music Cues[/b] - New music cues implemented for player death, fail, and win states.
[*][b]Visuals[/b] - Eden Corp Orbital Connectors, Orbital Rings, and updated Skybox added to Skybound, Vapor Exploit, Thundershock, and Showroom vistas.
[/list]

[i]New Content[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Boss Unlocked[/b] - Boss is now unlocked by default. Boss’s ability upgrades will still need to be unlocked.
[*][b]Vapor Exploit Dropships[/b] - In the Vapor Exploit mission, enemies will now spawn randomly throughout the map from incoming Eden Corp Security Deployment Dropships.
[*][b]Extermination Switch Puzzle[/b] - In the Extermination mission, the Switch Puzzle now scales with difficulty and multiplayer. Switch colors can also be adjusted to support visibility for colorblind players.
[*][b]Sound Effects[/b] - We’re in the process of updating many of the game’s legacy sound effects; quite a few have already been replaced, and there’s more to come!
[/list]

[i]New Functionality[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Single-Player Pause[/b] - Players can now pause the game in single-player! Open the in-game menu and select “Pause”; to resume gameplay, make sure you’re standing in the correct position (marked by footprints on the ground) and select “Resume.”
[*][b]Improved Hand Positioning[/b] - Greatly improved the accuracy of the rendered position of player’s virtual hands and held objects in relation to their real-life hands and controllers.
[*][b]Improved Teleshift Targeting[/b] - Teleshift beam will now arc towards the actual target location to clarify where players will end up when the straight beam does not actually point at the target location (such as towards max teleport location or at a wall).
[*][b]Preferences Tab[/b] - Players can now set the following options in the Preferences panel accessed within the Main Menu and In-Game Menu: Show/Hide Forearms, Show/Hide Playspace, Enable/Disable Late Update (experimental feature to improve hand tracking latency and performance that is disabled by default).
[*][b]Global Audio Balance Pass[/b] - Rebalanced all game audio to improve audio fidelity and level out volume more. Now, when you switch from a movie, music, or other game into [i]Raw Data[/i], the volume levels will be more consistent. (Note: if you had previously lowered [i]Raw Data[/i]’s volume in the Windows Volume Mixer, we recommend turning it back up now. We’ve also reset the in-game volume options to their defaults because of these changes.)
[*][b]Unreal Engine[/b] - [i]Raw Data[/i] is now built on Unreal Engine 4.13.2 with Survios customizations.
[/list]

[i]Gameplay and Balance Improvements[/i]
[b]Bishop[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Charged Shot[/b] - Charged Shot no longer pierces the environment, and its maximum collision radius has been reduced from 30 to 25. Charged Shot collision now ramps up over time.
[*][b]Time Warp[/b] - Time Warp duration reduced to 6 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Saija[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Flash Blade[/b] - Melee damage doubled.
[*][b]Katana Throw[/b] - Katana Throw return damaged increased by 6x so it now deals the same damage throughout the entire flight.
[*][b]Levitation Smash[/b] - Levitation Smash damage increased 6x. Cooldown increased by 10 seconds.
[*][b]Reflection Counter[/b] - Reflection Counter is now a base ability; you can now reflect projectiles without needing to forcibly strike them. The collision radius has been reduced, so it will require more precise positioning of the Flash Blade to reflect projectiles, but accuracy as a whole has been increased. Using the Flash Blade with two hands still increases reflection radius and damage.
[/list]
[b]Boss[/b]
[*][b]Dominator Shotgun[/b] - Spread pattern of Dominator Shotgun has been decreased and damage falloff reduced; together, these increase its effective combat range.
[*][b]Plasma Grenade[/b] - Plasma Grenade max damage reduced and damage falloff greatly reduced. Plasma Grenade is now an effective AoE weapon, rather than a single target destroyer.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hornet Drone[/b] - Hornet Drone’s collision sphere size increased.
[*][b]Enemy Spawn[/b] - Global enemy spawn tuning.
[*][b]Enemy Animations[/b] - General improvements to enemies’ physical animation.  Ragdolls during death are now blended with animation to create a more realistic effect.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Nuke Fusion[/b] - Overall difficulty reduced and Fusion Chamber capture mechanic simplified. When captured, a Mega Dynamo will drop in as before, but Eden forces no longer retain control of the Fusion chamber after the phase ends. Enemies should no longer teleshift into the Fusion Chambers after it has been captured. Instead, enemies will need to recapture the Fusion Chamber to call in more Mega Dynamos.
[*][b]Nanos[/b] - Dealing damage no longer awards nanos--only kills do.
[/list]

[i]Performance and Stability[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Physics[/b] - Mask physics stalls during heavy scenes by moving calculations to run alongside physics in parallel where possible.
[*][b]AI Capsules[/b] - Improvements to AI capsule overlaps.
[*][b]Turrets[/b] - Improvements to turrets.
[*][b]Spawning - Reduced spawning of hit and impact effects for over-time damage abilities
[*][b]Extermination Lasers[/b] - Improvements to lasers in Extermination mission
[*][b]Crusader Pistol[/b] - Improved spawning hit of Crusader Pistol’s projectiles.
[*][b]Net Update[/b] - Reduced Net update frequency for Actors across the board. This will decrease CPU load on the host.
[*][b]Animation[/b] - General improvements to AI animation performance.
[*][b]Dynamic Assets[/b] - Optimized memory footprint by dynamically loading assets only when needed and decreasing resolution of unnecessarily high resolution textures.
[*][b]Cubemap Reflections[/b] - Lowered graphics settings use a predetermined cubemap rather than cubemap reflections to avoid a minimal visual fidelity cost.
[/list]

[i]Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Host Crash[/b] - Fixed a bug that could cause the host to crash when a client player dies.
[*][b]Shotgun Physics[/b] - Fixed the physics on Boss’s Dominator Shotgun behaving erratically after being thrown.
[*][b]Air Juggle[/b] - Fixed an issue where Boss’s Air Juggle ability would not deactivate on holster after activation
[*][b]Server List[/b] - Fixed the server list browser not updating and displaying results. Also fixed the auto-search checkbox not displaying its state properly.
[*][b]Elevator Pause[/b] - Fixed long pause before elevator descent in Dark Source and Extermination missions.
[*][b]Lost “Sticky” Pistol[/b] - Fixed an issue where player randomly loses Crusader Pistol while playing on “Sticky” control scheme.
[*][b]Sticky Weapon Drop[/b] - Fixed an issue where players could sometimes drop their weapon despite being in Sticky mode.
[*][b]VIP Bots[/b] - Fixed an issue where VIP bots were unable to capture the Fusion Chamber in Nuke Fusion mission.
[*][b]Playspace[/b] - Fixed an issue where players standing outside their playspace on launch would end up in an unresponsive state.
[*][b]Bishop Charging VFX[/b] - Fixed an issue where clients playing Bishop could sometimes break the charging VFX on Charged Shot.
[*][b]Hovering Enemies[/b] - Fixed an issue where enemy bots could sometimes hover in the air at strange angles.
[*][b]Showroom Sunken Floor[/b] - Fixed an issue where players were sometimes sunken into the floor when returning to the Showroom.
[*][b]Showroom Freeze Fix[/b] - Fixed an issue where game could lock up and freeze in the Showroom.
[*][b]Client Player Spawn[/b] - Fixed client player spawning inside the elevator when going back up from a mission into Showroom.
[*][b]Host Start[/b] - Fixed a bug that could resort in the host not being able to start a mission after playing a mission with a client and returning back to Showroom.
[*][b]Dark Source Stuck Player[/b] - Fixed an issue where players can become stuck and unable to Teleshift in spawn halls on Dark Source mission after being knocked back from an explosion.
[*][b]Extermination Lasers[/b] - Fixed an issue where lasers would not properly display on client in Extermination mission.
[*][b]Extermination Freeze[/b] - Fixed an issue where the game could lock up and freeze in Extermination mission.
[*][b]Extractor Tooltip[/b] - Fixed an issue with the Extractor tooltip not displaying properly on some maps.
[*][b]Scroll[/b] - Fixed an issue where Developer Notes would not scroll.
[*][b]Private Listing[/b] - Fixed an issue that caused some private games to be listed publicly.
[*][b]Lighting[/b] - Fixed an issue that caused some lighting to display incorrectly when the player turned their head.
[*][b]Host Game[/b] - Fix for not being able to host a game after playing the defense placement training session due to a dummy player appearing in the player list.
[*][b]Saija Ability Meter[/b] - Fixed Saija’s ability meter icon getting stuck on Shuriken Stream or Gravity Thrust.
[*][b]Rack Up Scoreboard[/b] - Fixed rack up scoreboard appearing in the Showroom when a client joins a host who had the scoreboard show up earlier.
[/list]

[i]Known Issues[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Loading Screen[/b] - Loading screen is missing and some loads may take longer than normal as asynchronous loading has been disabled. This will be fixed in a future update.
[*][b]Enemy Physics[/b] - Enemy bodies sometimes behave erratically during hit reactions, especially when impacting with other geometry. This will be addressed in a future update.
[*][b]AI Elevation[/b] - Enemies will sometimes attempt to unsuccessfully target players on higher elevation. This will be addressed in a future update.
[*][b]Stuck Heavy Rocket Bot[/b] - Heavy rocket bots will sometimes stop walking.
[*][b]Disappearing Heavy Bots[/b] - Heavy bots sometimes disappear when killed.
[*][b]Ninja Bot Targeting[/b] - Ninja bots sometimes improperly target the Data Core.
[*][b]Turret Rotation[/b] - Turret’s rotation is jerky on client machines.
[*][b]Ammo Indicator[/b] - Boss’s ammo indicator animation can become unreliable.
[*][b]Floating Turrets[/b] - Placing Turrets or the Shield Station on an elevator will cause them to float in the air.
[*][b]Bluetooth Headsets[/b] - When playing with a Bluetooth headset that has a built-in mic, audio may not be routed through the headset. Current workarounds include disabling/uninstalling headset so audio is routed to HMD, or changing Steam VR settings to force audio to be routed to headset.
[/list]

notes.title: A Letter to the VR Community from Survios
notes.content:
Hi all! We’re very excited to announce that [url=http://venturebeat.com/2016/12/13/vr-game-studio-survios-nabs-mgm-as-investor-in-fundings-totaling-50-million/]Survios has closed new funding totaling $50 million[/url], led by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/0baecd334dd3440f96c6a6940356a276eaf0d09f.gif[/img]

I want to take this moment to thank everyone for this opportunity to make something great together. We would not be where we are today without you. For VR technology to have advanced this far this fast is incredible, and it’s all due to the limitless vision and tireless dedication of its advocates—this amazing community of VR gamers, developers, enthusiasts, and visionaries. From content creators to passionate players, you have all directly contributed to VR solidifying its status as [i]the[/i] new entertainment medium. And for that, we thank you.

When we got started with our first tech demo, a little period shooter called [i][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ovhwSS86Km8]Zombies on the Holodeck![/url][/i], we never dreamed that in a few short years we’d be here with this amazing community having a blast making what we love. Now that the industry is beginning to move past early adoption and into more mainstream awareness, we consider ourselves very lucky and blessed to be able to develop and deliver the best VR content we can muster. 

From the get-go, Survios’ driving motivation has been to create breathtaking VR experiences—and that hasn’t changed. As we continue to grow, we can now enable others to realize their dreams. Through Survios’ publishing support, we aim to provide a wide range of resources so that devs can concentrate on what really matters: creating awesome experiences from the ground up for VR and sharing them with a community that cares.

What does this mean for [i]Raw Data[/i]? Our mission hasn’t changed. We are going to complete [i]Raw Data[/i] as we originally set out to do, delivering more missions, heroes, items, and abilities; further polishing the gameplay; and adding in lots of story-driven elements so that the finished product is not only super fun to play, but also has the depth and fullness you crave. We also have a few unannounced surprises in store for you along the way. :) Stay tuned for more about that!

Again, thank you so much for your ongoing support of both Survios and VR. 

Best,
James & Survios Team

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/72b28ebec62cbca86863f8f03575ad7a87341fca.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Survios Community Reps
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Spencer here--you guys may know me as the Lord of VR Badassery and, since Early Access launch, Survios’ unofficial community rep. I’ve chatted with a bunch of you here on Steam, met you guys at events like PAX and E3, and gotten you hyped for new [i]Raw Data[/i] content with our update release streams.

It’s been super exciting to watch our community grow so rapidly, and alongside that, the Survios team has grown as well in both size and scope. That’s why I’m here talking to you guys: my responsibilities at Survios are continuing to grow in new and exciting directions, so I’m passing the Steam baton.

Starting this week, you’ll see an account titled [b]Survios[/b] posting around these parts. It’s a three-headed dragon run by our awesome community team:
[list]
[*][b]Roger[/b], our community manager, dreams up the epic contests, giveaways, and partnerships that lets us see how creative you can be.
[*][b]Lauren[/b], our content strategist, is the wordsmith behind our long-form posts--content updates, hero spotlights, concept art--and helms our three [url=https://twitter.com/Survios]social[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/survios/]media[/url] [url=https://www.facebook.com/surviosvr]channels[/url].
[*][b]Amy[/b], our marketing assistant, handles influencer relations and maintains our community VIP list. Fitting, since she’s a streamer herself!
[/list]
All three of them will be posting here under the Survios handle and signing their posts accordingly. They love killing robots as much as we do, so I know they’ll take good care of you guys!

It’s been a blast, and don’t worry: this isn’t goodbye. You’ll still see me on streams and working events, so I’m not actually going anywhere. ːsteamhappyː Keep being awesome, and I thank you all for the opportunity to get to know and slaughter 'bots with you.

Signing off,
Spencer

P.S. Additionally, if you’ve done any dealings with Delegate_4753 (a.k.a. our customer support reps), that account will also be changing names. Going forward, all customer support, troubleshooting, and feedback inquiries will be handled by the aptly-named [b]Survios_CS[/b]. Same awesome people helping you out, newer straightforward name!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.4 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

In the wake of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/724346080695842247]State of Raw Data[/url] post we made earlier, we've got another performance/stability-based hotfix ready for you!

[b][i]Patch Notes for Hotfix 0.4.4[/i][/b] [i](Released November 15):[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Travel Crash[/b]: Fixed physics-related crash that would often happen when traveling to another map
[*][b]Memory Stomp[/b]: Fixed memory stomp in rendering code that would cause random mid-game crashes
[*][b]Leaderboard Crash[/b]: Fixed crash that would often occur when looking at leaderboards
[*][b]Object Crash[/b]: Fixed a rare crash in rendering code when updating objects' positions
[*][b]Showroom Freeze[/b]: Fixed freeze in showroom
[*][b]CPU Spikes[/b]: Fixed a rare issue causing huge CPU spikes (up to 7k ms). [i]Thank you Graeme for sending us your profiling logs![/i]
[*][b]Texture[/b]: Fixed a texture memory leak 
[*][b]Defense Spawner[/b]: Fixed defense spawner always showing 0 nanos
[*][b]Footstep Audio[/b]: Player’s own avatar footsteps are no longer audible
[/list]

With our new emphasis on performance, your feedback is more important than ever, so please continue sharing your input on the forums here and via our official [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/feedback/]Feedback Form[/url] and [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url]. Thanks so much!

notes.title: Community Update - State of Raw Data
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/81029b71444930ddfe4ddd42a3258daa97c5b891.png[/img]

Hi everyone! James here with a quick update on the state of [i]Raw Data[/i].

Thank you everyone in the [i]Raw Data[/i] community for making this game the best it can possibly be! We started this journey together because we’re driven to create a VR game that strikes every sci-fi chord in the spectrum and empowers players to feel like a total badass. I think we are well on our way to accomplishing this mission together.

We have a ton of updates and expansions planned for [i]Raw Data[/i] in both the near and far future, and we cannot wait to share the progress with you. The [i]Raw Data[/i] universe has expanded a ton since its inception and, due to your dedication and passion, we have been able to put even more resources into bringing this game to life. Even in its current Early Access state, our work is far from complete, and we will not rest until we accomplish what we have set out to do as a team and as a community.

Speaking of updates: that’s what we’re here to talk about. With the cadence we’ve been keeping since [i]Raw Data[/i]’s Early Access launch in mid-July, you may be expecting another sizable content update, v0.5, to drop soon. However--with the exception of hotfixes--we've realized it is going to be a bit of a longer wait before we push the next chunk of missions and features. 

This is for a good reason.

Although the upcoming v0.5 release is the last big update of 2016, it's going to have a different focus than its predecessors. Previous updates largely hinged on massive content pushes bookended by community bug reporting and hotfixes. But the message we’ve been hearing throughout these past six months is that the game needs to play seamlessly. We hear you loud and clear. Getting [i]Raw Data[/i] to play smooth as butter and meet performance expectations has become our top priority for the remainder of the year.

New content is amazing--and believe us, we still have a ton in store!--but first and foremost, we want [i]Raw Data[/i] to be a high-quality VR gaming experience for everyone, no matter what your setup, room scale, hardware specs, hero choice, playstyle...the list goes on. As a result, Update v0.5 is all about [i]Raw Data[/i]’s performance, stability, balance, and polish. We are also using this opportunity to get the music and narrative elements (yay, more Simon!) back up to speed with the rest of the game.

We know we say it a lot, but your ongoing feedback and communication about [i]Raw Data[/i] is truly invaluable to us; you’ve directly influenced numerous in-game features, brainstormed new ideas, devised novel solutions to common issues, and helped us tweak existing/planned features to ensure your needs are addressed. There are still more new missions, environment themes, enemy types, game mechanics, weapon types, special abilities, and deadly defenses yet to come (and yes, another playable hero who has been asked about a lot ːsteamhappyː)--and we can’t wait to add them in--but right now, it’s all about improving the core of [i]Raw Data[/i] and defining an infinitely enjoyable, massively replayable gameplay experience every time you slip on that HMD.

We sincerely thank you for your continued patience and support as we build [i]Raw Data[/i] into the ultimate immersive VR combat experience. Your passionate contributions are what make this project a joy for us to work on, every single day.

We’ll see you back in Eden soon!

Signing off,

James & the [i]Raw Data[/i] team


P.S. As we shift toward this emphasis on performance, your feedback is more important than ever! Please continue sharing your input on the forums here and via our official [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/feedback/]Feedback Form[/url] and [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/]Bug Reporting Form[/url].

P.P.S. For more cool content and news about Survios and [i]Raw Data[/i]--including contests and giveaways!--follow us on our social channels: [url=https://twitter.com/Survios]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/survios/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/surviosvr/]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.3 & Profiling Build Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks so much for all the feedback you've submitted on [i]Raw Data[/i] Update 0.4--hope you're enjoying playing like a Boss! And to keep you in the game, we've got another performance/stability hotfix ready for you. 

Additionally, if you've been experience performance issues with your game, we've released a profiling build that we can use to help fix your issues. The information is below the patch notes.

[i][b]Patch notes for Hotfix v.0.4.3[/b] (released October 27):[/i]

[b]UI/Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*][b]AA Graphics Setting[/b]: removed AA graphics setting since current AA implementation is not adequate for VR
[*][b]Screen Percentage[/b]: prevent setting screen percentage value below .8 (recommended settings now correctly set screen percentage at 1 or above)
[*][b]Screen Space Reflections[/b]: Fixed postprocess setting not affecting screen space reflections
[*][b]Reset Graphics Button[/b]: Renamed Reset Graphics Button to "Set Recommended" (it uses benchmark values to set recommended values for your system)
[*][b]Desktop Monitor Rendering[/b]: Added option to disable rendering on desktop monitor
[*][b]Menu Graphics[/b]: Fixed the in-game menu and main menu graphics options not being kept in (visual) sync
[*][b]HMD Resolutionp[/b]: Fixed monitor resolution affecting HMD resolution
[*][b]Blank Screen[/b]: Fixed blank screen appearing after double-tapping the "Quickplay" multiplayer button
[*][b]Rackup Screen[/b]: Fixed the rackup screen summary tile circular score bar not showing up
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enemy Collision[/b]: Optimizations on enemy collision
[*][b]Physics[/b]: Optimizing for heavy physics scenes on CPU
[*][b]Turrets[/b]: Fixed massive CPU performance hit when using turrets
[*][b]Meta Tool[/b]: CPU optimization on the Meta Tool UI
[*]Various small optimizations
[/list]

[b]Crashes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b]: Fixed crashes due to user images in leaderboards and friends screen
[*][b]Katana Throw[/b]: Fixed crash when using Katana Throw
[*][b]Shield Station[/b]: Fixed crashes that could occur after deploying Shield Station
[*]Various minor crash fixes
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Shotgun Shells[/b]: One shell in a shotgun blast will now always go straight to allow players to easily shoot down drones
[*][b]Lightning Damage[/b]: Reduced player damage dealt by lighting in Thundershock
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Razer Hydra[/b]: Removed Survios Razer Hydra development implementation so users can use the SteamVR driver
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]When playing multiplayer, a client may crash after repeated playthroughs when travelling to a new mission from the Showroom.
[*]During gameplay, there is a random rare crash in the rendering code. We have not discovered any particular steps to reproduce this yet.

notes.title: Parsing Raw Data: Creation of Boss
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ea9f5fcac15bd0f22c8f331ca047acb3dc2f6c11.jpg[/img]

Prior to [i]Raw Data[/i]’s Early Access launch in July, people who experienced our original demo didn’t play as Bishop or Saija or any specific heroes at all, but a generic character with access to four weapons spawned from a central terminal: a 10mm pistol, energy katana, pump-action shotgun, and compound bow with incendiary arrows.

When Early Access launched with Bishop and Saija, we revealed our plan for the polished game featuring individual playable heroes each linked to a specific weapon: Bishop with his Crusader Pistols, Saija with her Flash Blade. Of course, that meant there were still two spots left, teased with silhouettes in the early user manual.

And after two months and three major content updates, the next operative to join SyndiK8’s elite team has arrived: Boss. However, despite his take-charge name and explosive Dominator Shotgun, Boss went through a long evolutionary process before bursting onto the scene as SyndiK8’s badass Street Merc.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/84f5326c3916c8d42360583be5847afd008c578f.jpg[/img]

When Boss was first conceptualized, he still fit the name, but “Mob Boss” might have been more fitting: the original concepts for the SyndiK8 heroes had them clad in business suits befitting of an Eden Corp executive, since the initial premise was infiltration from the inside. The shotgun had to have an appropriately heavy-hitting character to wield it, and the original model for Assault (as he was codenamed) more resembled a Bond villain’s strongman sidekick.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7e4dff9073c7f6cddbae2e9d2e633ec585c2ed92.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b47d1fc092634334c92578e08533a3673aae6f63.jpg[/img]

However, as individual backstories were built out for each hero and the “Eden executive” disguise idea was dropped, it became clear that Boss was going to need a more unique aesthetic to match his history: he has a personal beef with Eden Corp because they’re directly responsible for the destruction of his family legacy. While he maintained his original role as the tank in SyndiK8’s elite lineup, his old mobster suit, polished shoes, and helmet-head weren’t going to be the right fit. (Of course, it's always possible that this initial design will resurface again in the future.)

With “techno-mercenary” as the new point of reference, Boss was completely reimagined as an anti-hero whose entire persona projects a simple message: [b]don’t mess with me.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/336604488151d915face9bb5e1148f33f94b24e3.jpg[/img]

Okay, so it took a couple iterations for the suit to completely disappear, but it was promptly covered up by a leather trenchcoat that has persisted into the final design and become a favorite of the [i]Raw Data[/i] costume closet.

First to go was the helmet, a central feature of the original design. When you’ve made a name for yourself as Neo-Shinjuku’s go-to gun for hire, you want your adversaries to know your face; hiding it behind a wall of metal would be cowardly. We paid homage to his original headgear with nanotech-enhanced tattoos wrapping around his head.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/240df184a9f15de1b607d8f44e209bf058169126.jpg[/img]

But an intimidating Street Merc has to be outfitted with some of the sweetest (and hardest-hitting) biotech available to show off his status, so while the helmet went by the wayside, the metal didn’t. It just shifted down to where it could pack the most punch, literally: his arms.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b69e5f19cf0ab5328e2f9829b31f1e2c7fc5bcec.jpg[/img]

Boss comes outfitted with a pair of Zaitomo bionic arms, a full shoulder-to-finger prosthetic that gives him extra strength and stability. These adamantium appendages allow him to fire his explosive Dominator Shotgun one-handed with little recoil and, when powered up, to deliver a knockout melee blow sure to shatter a synthetic’s jaw. (That latter feature requires a hardware upgrade that’s currently in development.)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f084c10c0facdd51e64ffc303203944aa1b9850f.jpg[/img]

The Zaitomo arms also were the catalyst to cut the sleeves off Boss’s stylish trenchcoat, so he could show off his guns, both figuratively and literally. The coat was also left hanging open to display not the original suit and tie, but some badass form-fitting body armor befitting of his role as the frontline bullet sponge.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/051ec4c375f7f605e361d2954363caa749eb1500.jpg[/img]

Once those Zaitomo arms were installed and the trenchcoat hemmed, all that was needed was to revisit Boss’s weapon of choice and give it the appearance fitting of its moniker: the Dominator Shotgun.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/afb232a9df81bfa6efe3c60e5e889b166f05adac.jpg[/img]

Originally conceived as a modified shotgun swiped from Eden’s corporate arsenal--hence the sleek white and matte black finish--the Dominator now has a more natural color scheme befitting of its streetwise source, but with some personalized flair: its barrel sports laser etchings that echo Boss’s cranial tattoos.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d68ebf351be1f9ebe1d6503a3333f25b79422ff2.jpg[/img]

The shotgun can also do a lot more now than just pop out shells, too. You can read Boss’s full ability rundown in our complete Boss hero spotlight), but all of his existing abilities revolve around the Dominator and its high-tech upgrades:
[list]
[*][b][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/637d6c61bcaa21070e4d7e83927333ebd27a240e.gif]Nade Launcher[/url][/b] enables the shotgun to launch up to three plasma grenades at a time, which are then slowly regenerated with no need for a physical reload.
[*][b]Quad Chamber[/b] enables you to prime four shots with a single pump, reducing the need to pump the shotgun from 12 times per clip to three.
[*][b][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/112e40089fffa5cf676873a8d7171687c1d983d5.gif]Air Juggle[/url][/b] is an explosive AOE flak blast that hurls nearby enemies up into the air, leaving them suspended and helpless for a brief period.
[/list]

And there’s a lot more of his abilities to come in future content updates, including his EXE ultimate ability [b]Earthquake Slam[/b], a passive upgrade for his Zaitomo arms that boosts his punching power, and an earth-shattering AOE.

His lone-wolf aura aside, Boss plays well with others--if they’re helping him get paid [i]and[/i] take down Eden Corp, there’s no reason to make enemies of them. And when he’s back-to-back with either Bishop or Saija, an explosively good time is guaranteed...except maybe for Eden.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/95c8c9b4720dfafd483e188e527da678c03b3867.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.1 and 0.4.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks so much for all the feedback you've submitted on [i]Raw Data[/i] Update 0.4--we've already been able to put together a couple hotfixes addressing some issues, which is now live!

[b]Patch notes for Hotfix v.0.4.2[/b] (released October 14):
[list]
[*]Fixed a few more crash-causing issues.
[*]Anti-aliasing setting temporarily disabled to guarantee optimal user experience (UI is still there).
[*]Fixed an issue with graphics benchmarks affecting the resolution scaler multiplier (it’s now 1 by default). This should address some performance issues reported by users with non-standard display sizes.
[*]Fixed a problem on clients with grenade firing mode getting stuck on Boss’ shotgun in high ping environments.
[*]Disabled motion control late update because it was causing hand stutters for some users.
[*]Audio will now maintain volume when application loses focus. This should address some issues reported by users who could not hear any audio after launching the game.
[/list]

[b]Patch notes for Hotfix 0.4.1[/b] (released October 13):
[list]
[*]Fixed several reported crashes.
[*]Fixed issue with 2-handed Flash Blade grip.
[*]Added force feedback and SFX for Boss's Proximity Reload.
[*]Added a check on startup that unlocks the next mission in progression if the previous mission has been completed. This should keep players from having to replay Vapor Exploit to unlock the new Extermination mission.
[/list]

Have fun, and don't forget to record your most badass Boss kills for our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/963034136883484625]#PlayLikeABoss contest[/url] to win an Intel Core i7 processor!

notes.title: The Boss Update 0.4 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b3e287948a232985df0a2a1df6593a5a7854e3d5.jpg[/img]

Greetings, SyndiK8 ops!

Yep, this is the transmission you’ve been anticipating for a while. We’ve got a new elite recruit officially ready to join the fight against Eden Corp, and his timing couldn’t have been better. Thanks to parsing all that raw data you’ve uploaded so far, we’ve gained access to two high-security areas deeper within Eden Tower.

However, we don’t exactly know what’s in there--but that’s where you come in, right?


[b]NEW CONTENT & FEATURES[/b]

[b][i]New Playable Hero - Boss, the Street Merc[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/9ec927c08fdd7112da74d08659592ac4e6b9bcbf.jpg[/img]

A hardened survivor of Neo-Shinjuku’s street gangs, Boss blasts robots into scrap with his trusty shotgun or bashes them to pieces with a literal iron fist.

Boss’s loadout and abilities are covered in-depth in his [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/972040700519092375]Hero Spotlight[/url], but here’s a quick dossier to get you started.

[i]Note: Boss will not be available at game startup--he must be unlocked by completing the existing missions, including the two new missions added with this update (Extermination and Thundershock).[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dceac73cdbf6d92a13536f3e227cc0d75b00d08e.gif[/img]

Boss comes equipped with the [b]Dominator Shotgun[/b], and that name isn’t an exaggeration. This pump-action powerhouse of a weapon fires heavy-duty shells and plasma grenades, both of which can effectively obliterate your enemies on their own.

But be sure to aim true, because this amount of firepower also requires patience on your part: while you can shoot one-handed, you’ll need both hands to pump the shotgun after every shell.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/637d6c61bcaa21070e4d7e83927333ebd27a240e.gif[/img]

The Dominator Shotgun has four unlockable upgrades:
[list]
[*][b]Quad Chamber[/b]: shotgun will only need to be pumped after four shots (as opposed to after every shot)
[*][b]Proximity Reload[/b]: automatically reloads when gun is touched to right shoulder; you will still have to pump the shotgun to prime the first shell
[*][b]Air Juggle[/b]: explosive AOE that launches enemies into the air, so you and your mission partner can pick them off like clay pigeons
[*][b]Nade Launcher[/b]: fire up to three plasma grenades that regenerate after a brief cooldown (track their availability via the display on the side of the shotgun)
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/112e40089fffa5cf676873a8d7171687c1d983d5.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ab2d4017fd64346b11529926e2b1afb710f15d0d.gif[/img]

[i]Note: This is not Boss’s complete loadout. Additional abilities will be added in a future update![/i]


[b][i]New Mission - Extermination[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8b38f08fe1041235a0fab7eeaace4f21d55312de.jpg[/img]

Descend down into Eden’s old Teleshift labs. This area’s pretty much abandoned, so it shouldn’t be a problem.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d8a9c3b7030af8c0a8c11751056ebabd91a57eef.gif[/img]

Nah, just joking. We’re aware of an ancient (by technology standards) “Extermination Protocol” set up as a security system. And if I know these older setups, that can only mean one thing: lasers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ead7a7fb424af667a3043c384310bbadb286008e.gif[/img]

You’d better know what to do when you encounter lasers; otherwise, we may need to schedule an early performance review.

[i]To unlock Extermination, you must beat the Vapor Exploit mission again, even if you have completed it before.[/i]


[b][i]New Mission - Thundershock[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dfaaddda631eed1222a8b81c7f4b88153782475a.jpg[/img]

The good: we’ve unlocked a convenient shortcut across the Eden rooftop.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3f0cd8ce256860957225ddc4f8bda237b70251f6.jpg[/img]

The bad: this area seems to have taken on the role of a giant lightning rod, as excess energy has reacted with atmospheric solar winds.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/12119bed3ae44b30d52741126d1175ee57700b2d.gif[/img]

The result is a perfect storm of brutal electrical strikes that are deadly to you, but almost seem to supercharge your robot friends. If you see one get hit, make it your top priority to take it out!

[i]To unlock Thundershock, you must beat the Extermination mission.

Note from the devs: these missions are in an incomplete state. Because we are shipping our missions as first playables, they do not have the latest dialogue VO, music cues, narrative items, challenges, or objectives in-game yet.[/i]


[b][i]New Defense - Shield Station[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ed51c7f2e78419e8b344471ae596d7f95a5f5b81.jpg[/img]

Feeling a bit overwhelmed? Deploy a strategic Shield Station for an instant--albeit temporary-- reprieve. This pop-up barrier protects you and any defenses within it from incoming projectiles for a short period of time.


[b][i]New Enemy - Teleshifting Mekomo[/i][/b]
Eden Corp’s given their favorite katana-wielding synthetic model another software upgrade that’s overridden its prior cloaking ability with Teleshift capabilities. While it’s no longer invisible, that doesn’t mean it’s easier to hit--if anything, it’ll be harder. Stay alert!


[b][i]New Feature - Multiplayer Leaderboards[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ebbf6c205d5c5ef5771564b737ff3f7dba5848d2.jpg[/img]

Striving for the top spot is no longer a solo sport: co-op teams can now compete for the high score on SyndiK8’s wall of infamy. Player teams are ranked by total score, but also show each player’s individual hero choices and scores.


[b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS & BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Death and Held Weapons[/i][/b] - After dying, you’ll automatically respawn holding whatever weapon(s) you were holding prior to death, so you can get back into the fight faster!
[*][b][i]Easy Difficulty[/i][/b] - Easy Difficulty is more player-friendly overall with increased player health and damage, lowered volley shot count, and increased Data Core health. 
[*][b][i]Hard and Nightmare Difficulties[/i][/b] - Reduced Data Core health.
[*][b][i]Mission Balance: Nuke Fusion[/i][/b] - Waves have been rebalanced to smooth out difficulty, while the center beacon has been split into two (one for each lane) to improve map flow.
[*][b][i]Mission Balance: Dark Source[/i][/b] - Reduced enemy wave numbers.
[*][b][i]Katana Throw Damage Trails[/i][/b] - Saija’s Katana Throw now features light trails to visualize the amount of damage being dealt. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
[*][b][i]Ability Balance: Katana Throw[/i][/b] - Katana Throw’s distance and speed are now affected by actual throw speed. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
[*][b][i]Charged Shot VFX[/i][/b] - Bishop's Crusader Pistol now shakes slightly when charging up. Additionally, visual recoil when firing Charged Shot (one hand) or Fusion Shot (both hands) has been increased.
[*][b][i]UI Scrolling[/i][/b] - You can now scroll through UI scroll lists by pointing at it with your dominant hand and swiping your thumb on the touchpad.
[/list]


[b]ART/AUDIO[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6d58927c015b33dab120c8ae2091f141e737e51a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b][i]Updated Model - Plasma Turret[/i][/b] - The Plasma Turret has a new model to visually distinguish it from the Laser Turret.
[*][b][i]Updated Music Cues[/i][/b] - New music cues for ambient and apprehension states in Nuke Fusion and all “Data Chamber” missions. [i]More music with intros and attack cues to be added later.[/i]
[/list]


[b]PERFORMANCE/STABILITY[/b]

[i]As we continue to refine our performance benchmarks and machine configurations, please note that your graphics settings will be automatically reset with this update.[/i]

[list]
[*][b][i]Main Menu[/i][/b] - In game UI has been significantly optimized to minimize CPU load
[*][b][i]Controller Latency[/i][/b] - Motion controller update has been implemented to minimize hand-tracked latency. If you bring up the SteamVR compositor and move your hands, you should now see negligible delay between the SteamVR controller model and your avatar hands.
[*][b][i]Matchfinding[/i][/b] - Optimization to Matchfinding avatars to reduce CPU load.
[*][b][i]Interaction Overlaps[/i][/b] - Player interaction overlaps have been refactored to improve CPU performance.
[*][b][i]Animation Logic[/i][/b] - Player and AI animation logic have been adjusted for CPU performance.
[*][b][i]Visual Optimizations[/i][/b] - Various FX and material optimizations for GPU performance.
[*][b][i]Stability[/i][/b] - Various crash and stability improvements across the board.
[/list]


[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Friendlists[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where large steam friendlists would cause intermittent slow downs.
[*][b][i]Voice Chat[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue that caused voice chat to work intermittently.
[*][b][i]Voice Sync[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where voice chat could lose sync and play 5-10 seconds delayed.
[*][b][i]Mute[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where the “Mute outgoing voice” option was non-functional.
[*][b][i]Progression[/i][/b] - Fixed a potential non-progression issue in Vapor Exploit mission.
[*][b][i]Windows N Intro Bypass[/i][/b] - Added functionality to allow users on Windows N (Anniversary update) who are lacking the proper Windows Media Player components to progress past the Survios intro movie.
[*][b][i]Leaderboards[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where users could encounter a freeze when switching leaderboards.
[*][b][i]Scores[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue in Leaderboards where the same score would be displayed every 10 ranks.
[*][b][i]Stuck Hands[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where players could get both hands stuck to their gun with the sticky control scheme.
[*][b][i]Graphic Settings[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where graphics settings were not resetting properly.
[*][b][i]Beam[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo laser beam impact effect would persist on death.
[*][b][i]Jitter[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo would jitter while moving on ramps.
[*][b][i]Mega Mekomo[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Mega Mekomo would not attack the Data Core.
[*][b][i]Ground Attacks[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where ground Mekomos could perform melee attacks against the Data Core while not in range.
[*][b][i]HMD Buffer[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where the HMD buffer size was tied to window mirror size.

And as always, we want to hear your ongoing thoughts on how we can better support your mission into Eden Corp! Join us on the Steam discussion forum and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/feedback]Feedback Form[/url] and [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug]Bug Reporting Form[/url] to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck–we look forward to reviewing your latest reports, especially from those of you opting to team up with Boss!

Striving for the top spot is no longer a solo sport: co-op teams can now compete for the high score on SyndiK8’s wall of infamy. Player teams are ranked by total score, but also show each player’s individual hero choices and scores.


[b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS & BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Death and Held Weapons[/i][/b] - After dying, you’ll automatically respawn holding whatever weapon(s) you were holding prior to death, so you can get back into the fight faster!
[*][b][i]Easy Difficulty[/i][/b] - Easy Difficulty is more player-friendly overall with increased player health and damage, lowered volley shot count, and increased Data Core health. 
[*][b][i]Hard and Nightmare Difficulties[/i][/b] - Reduced Data Core health.
[*][b][i]Mission Balance: Nuke Fusion[/i][/b] - Waves have been rebalanced to smooth out difficulty, while the center beacon has been split into two (one for each lane) to improve map flow.
[*][b][i]Mission Balance: Dark Source[/i][/b] - Reduced enemy wave numbers.
[*][b][i]Katana Throw Damage Trails[/i][/b] - Saija’s Katana Throw now features light trails to visualize the amount of damage being dealt. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
[*][b][i]Ability Balance: Katana Throw[/i][/b] - Katana Throw’s distance and speed are now affected by actual throw speed. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
[*][b][i]Charged Shot VFX[/i][/b] - Bishop's Crusader Pistol now shakes slightly when charging up. Additionally, visual recoil when firing Charged Shot (one hand) or Fusion Shot (both hands) has been increased.
[*][b][i]UI Scrolling[/i][/b] - You can now scroll through UI scroll lists by pointing at it with your dominant hand and swiping your thumb on the touchpad.
[/list]


[b]ART/AUDIO[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6d58927c015b33dab120c8ae2091f141e737e51a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b][i]Updated Model - Plasma Turret[/i][/b] - The Plasma Turret has a new model to visually distinguish it from the Laser Turret.
[*][b][i]Updated Music Cues[/i][/b] - New music cues for ambient and apprehension states in Nuke Fusion and all “Data Chamber” missions. [i]More music with intros and attack cues to be added later.[/i]
[/list]


[b]PERFORMANCE/STABILITY[/b]

[i]As we continue to refine our performance benchmarks and machine configurations, please note that your graphics settings will be automatically reset with this update.[/i]

[list]
[*][b][i]Main Menu[/i][/b] - In game UI has been significantly optimized to minimize CPU load
[*][b][i]Controller Latency[/i][/b] - Motion controller update has been implemented to minimize hand-tracked latency. If you bring up the SteamVR compositor and move your hands, you should now see negligible delay between the SteamVR controller model and your avatar hands.
[*][b][i]Matchfinding[/i][/b] - Optimization to Matchfinding avatars to reduce CPU load.
[*][b][i]Interaction Overlaps[/i][/b] - Player interaction overlaps have been refactored to improve CPU performance.
[*][b][i]Animation Logic[/i][/b] - Player and AI animation logic have been adjusted for CPU performance.
[*][b][i]Visual Optimizations[/i][/b] - Various FX and material optimizations for GPU performance.
[*][b][i]Stability[/i][/b] - Various crash and stability improvements across the board.
[/list]


[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Friendlists[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where large steam friendlists would cause intermittent slow downs.
[*][b][i]Voice Chat[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue that caused voice chat to work intermittently.
[*][b][i]Voice Sync[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where voice chat could lose sync and play 5-10 seconds delayed.
[*][b][i]Mute[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where the “Mute outgoing voice” option was non-functional.
[*][b][i]Progression[/i][/b] - Fixed a potential non-progression issue in Vapor Exploit mission.
[*][b][i]Windows N Intro Bypass[/i][/b] - Added functionality to allow users on Windows N (Anniversary update) who are lacking the proper Windows Media Player components to progress past the Survios intro movie.
[*][b][i]Leaderboards[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where users could encounter a freeze when switching leaderboards.
[*][b][i]Scores[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue in Leaderboards where the same score would be displayed every 10 ranks.
[*][b][i]Stuck Hands[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where players could get both hands stuck to their gun with the sticky control scheme.
[*][b][i]Graphic Settings[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where graphics settings were not resetting properly.
[*][b][i]Beam[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo laser beam impact effect would persist on death.
[*][b][i]Jitter[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo would jitter while moving on ramps.
[*][b][i]Mega Mekomo[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where Mega Mekomo would not attack the Data Core.
[*][b][i]Ground Attacks[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where ground Mekomos could perform melee attacks against the Data Core while not in range.
[*][b][i]HMD Buffer[/i][/b] - Fixed an issue where the HMD buffer size was tied to window mirror size.

And as always, we want to hear your ongoing thoughts on how we can better support your mission into Eden Corp! Join us on the Steam discussion forum and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/feedback]Feedback Form[/url] and [url=https://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug]Bug Reporting Form[/url] to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck–we look forward to reviewing your latest reports, especially from those of you opting to team up with Boss!

notes.title: Hero Spotlight: Boss, the Street Merc
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/9ec927c08fdd7112da74d08659592ac4e6b9bcbf.jpg[/img]

Hello, and welcome to the third [i]Raw Data[/i] hero spotlight! In this series, we’ll give you insight into how SyndiK8’s top operatives utilize nanotechnology to gain enhanced abilities, both through their weapons and with their minds.

By now, you’ve all had almost three months to perfect your pistols as Bishop or hone your blade as Saija--but the dynamic duo is about to become a trio. [i]Raw Data[/i] Early Access Update 0.4 arrives next week, and it introduces the first new playable hero since launch: Boss the Street Merc.

You got the initial hints at his abilities in last week’s [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/436320/announcements/detail/972040066615207233]Sneak Peek[/url], but now it’s time to formally make his acquaintance.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/edd8489644cc3ebb767379ed4b7c99fe5d9d2c7f.jpg[/img]

Boss brings a ton of firepower to the fight against Eden Corp thanks to a pump-action shotgun that launches both heavy-duty shells and plasma grenades.

And while his intimidating presence--especially those Zaitomo bionic arms--paints him as an antihero loner, Boss is quickly becoming SyndiK8’s top op to send out as half of a pair: his skills are perfectly complimented by a partner’s special abilities.


[b][i]This is My Boomstick[/i][/b]

After Bishop’s pistols and Saija’s katana, the next weapon we had to bring in was the appropriately-named [b]Dominator Shotgun[/b], so named because it owns anyone unfortunate enough to be caught in its sights.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/16771ab455ec9f51c17e83ef97424c3b283c8c58.gif[/img]

The shotgun is made to blow away whatever it crosses, but with great power comes great...endurance. You can grab and fire with just your dominant hand, but you’ll need both to prime each shot: although the Dominator’s clip holds 12 shells, you need to pump the shotgun between each shot.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dceac73cdbf6d92a13536f3e227cc0d75b00d08e.gif[/img]

As you complete missions with Boss, you’ll unlock more shotgun upgrades. [b]Quad Chamber[/b] reduces the need to pump the shotgun to every four shots, giving your arm a break. And there’s [b]Proximity Reload[/b], which is similar to Bishop’s ability of the same name: you can automatically reload the shotgun simply by touching it to your shoulder, without having to grab a clip.


[b][i]Blow Us All Away[/i][/b]

The Dominator Shotgun doesn’t just fire shells. It’s also got a few tricks up its barrel in the form of powerful plasma grenades that will obliterate any enemies in your path.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/637d6c61bcaa21070e4d7e83927333ebd27a240e.gif[/img]

Pull the non-dominant Trigger to fire up to three grenades in a row. They’ll ricochet off any nearby solid surfaces and explode after a couple seconds of travel time. And the best part? There’s no need to reload grenades since they’re on a cooldown. Keep track of how many grenades are available on the cooldown display on the side of Boss’s shotgun, but be aware: these take time to regenerate, and they’re most effective (and destructive) when deployed more than one at a time.


[b][i]Get Some Air[/i][/b]

Boss comes into Update 0.4 with one weapon-based special ability, and it’s one your SyndiK8 teammate is sure to enjoy. [b]Air Juggle[/b] is an explosive AOE flak blast that hurls nearby enemies up into the air.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/112e40089fffa5cf676873a8d7171687c1d983d5.gif[/img]

Activate Air Juggle by pressing down and swiping left on dominant controller’s trackpad, then sit back and laugh as it turns Eden Corp synthetics into clay pigeons for Bishop’s Bulletstorm, Saija’s Katana Throw, and, of course, Boss’s Dominator. Who’s up for some target practice?!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/261dac0b1b533b1c1d53abac05e2d6240c236bd4.gif[/img]

In a future update, Air Juggle will also meet its perfect ability partner: Boss’s EXE Ultimate [b]Earthquake Slam[/b]. We can’t reveal specifics yet, but let’s just say that what goes up must come down--and this landing is anything but soft.


[b][i]C’mon, Take a Shot[/i][/b]

Between his crazy shotgun and biomech upgrades, Boss is truly an unstoppable force and an incredible asset to SyndiK8’s ops team. But with slower reload and firing speeds and a grenade cooldown, his firepower comes at a slight price. It all balances out.

That’s why he fares best in a pair, trading shots with Bishop or lining up enemies for Saija to slice while keeping them from getting overwhelmed. And when Boss decides those robots need some airtime, everybody wins.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ab2d4017fd64346b11529926e2b1afb710f15d0d.gif[/img]

And with Boss on your team, ability combos just got that much more explosive:

[list]
[*]Air Juggle + Grenades: toss some into the airborne fray and enjoy the fireworks
[*]Air Juggle + Charged Shot/Bullettime/Bulletstorm (Bishop): pop enemies up into the air, then slow time down for you each to take your best pot shots
[*]Air Juggle + Katana Throw/Shuriken Stream (Saija): the Cyber Ninja will thank you for giving her boomerang so many ‘bots to slice through
[*]Grenade + Teleshift + Shotgun: send an enemy staggering with a well-aimed grenade, then rush forward to deliver a satisfyingly literal final blow
[/list]

After a few successful missions, you’ll deliver a solid message to Eden Corp: [i]you’re not the Boss of me now.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/71debb23c0d30229ec4486229e9c21dd46acb957.gif[/img]

Oh, and the best part about Boss? This isn’t it--he’s got way more badass abilities on the way in future updates, including an upgrade for those metallic muscles that will give him some serious punching power.

notes.title: Sneak Peek: The Boss Update 0.4 (Part 2)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dd49058413ffb110da10d838de32e707658495ba.jpg[/img]

Hey ops–I’m back. And I’ve got some great news.

We’ve got a new recruit itching to join the fight. The quick dossier I got on him classifies him as a Street Merc: he’s risen through the ranks of several brutal gangs to become a top dog respected not just for his brute strength and gun skills, but also his technical know-how.

But all of this has just been training for his primary mission–he’s got one hell of a personal beef with Eden Corp, and he wants to settle this score once and for all.

So we’ve got a hardened veteran of the streets who packs a ton of firepower and can literally hack it with the best of them (just look at that custom-programmed bionic arm!). If his gun can’t blow the heads off those damn Eden robots, nothing can.

It’s time for you to meet…[b]Boss[/b]. I’m sending along some graphics of his loadout from his recruit file.

[b][i]New Playable Hero: Boss[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d68ebf351be1f9ebe1d6503a3333f25b79422ff2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/cd36b087fc484fd3c21c0473b2073843b44a939b.jpg[/img]

I think you will get along nicely, so it’s time to arrange a debrief on his strengths and abilities. Let’s bring him in!

[i]Coming next week: get ready to get your boomstick on with Boss’s Hero Spotlight.[/i]

notes.title: Sneak Peek: The Boss Update 0.4 (Part 1)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3f0cd8ce256860957225ddc4f8bda237b70251f6.jpg[/img]

Greetings, SyndiK8 ops!

As we disclosed last week, thanks to your efforts, we’ve extracted tons of valuable information with regards to Eden Corp’s digital infrastructure. What does that mean for you? Two new missions, two new opportunities to extract more of that sweet, sweet raw data.

However, Eden’s security system is getting a bit paranoid, so their protocols have been--shall we say--heightened a bit.


[b][i]New Mission: Thundershock[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dfaaddda631eed1222a8b81c7f4b88153782475a.jpg[/img]

Eden’s robotics facilities and fusion reactor are going crazy trying to keep up with all of the damage you’ve inflicted. While it’s great that we’re overloading their systems, it’s had an unexpected side effect: seems all that excess electrical energy have reacted with the solar winds in the atmosphere to generate a perfect storm.

Make your way across the Eden rooftop, but be wary of those brutal lightning strikes. While they’ll hit you like a ton of bricks, the robots seem almost--rejuvenated. So be sure to dodge the elements while also quickly taking out any enemies revitalized by the surge.


[b][i]New Mission: Extermination[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8b38f08fe1041235a0fab7eeaace4f21d55312de.jpg[/img]

Survived the strikes? Then it’s time to descend into the ancient (by Eden standards) Teleshift laboratory, where the technology was first devised--and where nobody’s set foot since it was mysteriously sealed up tight.

Except you, of course. And apparently there’s some sort of old “Extermination Protocol” in place that’ll probably be triggered, and if I know these older setups, that can only mean one thing: lasers. Lots and lots of advanced security lasers. Hope you’re ready for some dancing, because these will put your dexterity to the test…


...Hold up. I just got an urgent transmission.

It sounds like we’ve got something else to share, but I’ve got to review some files first. I’ll check back in with you soon...

[i]Stay tuned for Part 2, coming later this week![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8b38f08fe1041235a0fab7eeaace4f21d55312de.jpg[/img]

Survived the strikes? Then it’s time to descend into the ancient (by Eden standards) Teleshift laboratory, where the technology was first devised--and where nobody’s set foot since it was mysteriously sealed up tight.

Except you, of course. And apparently there’s some sort of old “Extermination Protocol” in place that’ll probably be triggered, and if I know these older setups, that can only mean one thing: lasers. Lots and lots of advanced security lasers. Hope you’re ready for some dancing, because these will put your dexterity to the test…


...Hold up. I just got an urgent transmission.

It sounds like we’ve got something else to share, but I’ve got to review some files first. I’ll check back in with you soon...

[i]Stay tuned for Part 2, coming later this week![/i]

notes.title: Raw Data Update 0.3 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/45d872adee27889080d951939ca4b3c7ee6dfcfa.jpg[/img]

Greetings, SyndiK8 operatives!

The data we’ve been collecting from your ventures into Eden Corp have been invaluable. Thanks to your ongoing feedback and reports, we’ve been able to put together our next big update for your mission.

For one, Mission Control has managed to get you access to a completely new area of Eden, and inside you’ll encounter two new enemies standing between you and your mission objective…

Here’s what’s just been implemented in Raw Data:

[u][b]New Content & Features[/b][/u]

[b][i]New Mission - Nuke Fusion[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/84fb257603e051094c94c43df7ae87b9ea068d52.jpg[/img]

Experience an all-new Data Chamber-centric area of Eden Corp. Shoot enemies and dodge death beams as you teleshift across precarious platforms, all radiating from the massive reactor powering Eden’s facilities.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f1ed9545ec36bede63646b5ec757cce7f03cc6c7.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1f3926250575e12a3b8f26c51ecb7d0000c7b667.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/08046f12ad2929c7395bea10f4df18d74c213c76.gif[/img]


[b][i]New Enemy - Mega Dynomo[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b369136c7a802766976a0ceae4a350c776f72bbb.gif[/img]

Dynomos aren’t the heaviest bots that Eden manufactures. With your continuous disruptions of their plan, they had to bring out the big guns–literally.

Meet the Mega Dynomo: your encounter with him is certain to be smashing. ([i]Pro tip: if you don’t want to deal with the Mega, take out those bots booking it to the reactor![/i])

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7f170e882109de8f7d918ac5a37fd2d93c40d319.jpg[/img]

[b][i]New Enemy – Beamfire Mekomo[/i][/b]
The upgraded model of the Burstfire Mekomo (of which you’ve already destroyed hundreds) fires solid plasma energy beams with far greater accuracy than its spray-and-pray brethren.

[b][i]New Defense – Plasma Turret[/i][/b]
Turrets: they’ve always got your back. Now you can get an even more powerful version that eschews lasers in favor of plasma-powered directed-energy beams.

[b][i]New Feature – Rack-Up Screen[/i][/b]
Once you’re back in the showroom after completing a mission, aNg3L will share a Data Link displaying your total uploaded raw data, mission scores, Crypto currency rewards, and available unlocked technologies–a.k.a. everything you need to know.

[b][i]New Feature – Difficulty System[/i][/b]
Whether you go it alone or team up with a fellow operative, now you can adjust how hard-hitting Eden’s security system handles your infiltration. There’s even a Nightmare mode for those daring (or foolish) enough to face a truly brutal challenge…

[b][i]New Feature – Leaderboards[/i][/b]
Think you’re the top of SyndiK8’s rankings? Now you can find out for sure with official Raw Data global rankings for individual players! ([i]Note: leaderboards will be periodically cleared throughout Early Access period.[/i])

[b][i]New Feature – Multiplayer Quickplay[/i][/b]
Teaming up is now easier! What are you waiting for? Humanity depends on you!


[u][b]Gameplay Improvements/Balance[/b][/u]

[b][i]Cloak Tekomo Improvements[/i][/b] – The Cloak Tekomo (“Ninja Bot”) has been gotten a software upgrade with new advanced dodging, cloaking, and combo mechanics. If you sense his presence, be sure to protect your turrets.

[b][i]Saija Buff[/i][/b] – Saija has received various buffs to her stats and abilities across the board that should make her more competitive with Bishop’s damage output.

[b][i]Cooldown Audio[/i][/b] – Added a sound effect to indicate when ability cooldowns have refreshed.


[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]

[b][i]Mission Return[/i][/b] – When you return to the showroom after a mission, the main menu now defaults to the level select screen if you are the game host or are a single player.

[b][i]Multiplayer Launch[/i][/b] – It is no longer possible to launch a multiplayer game with only one player in the lobby.

[b][i]Sky Push[/i][/b] – As Bishop, it is no longer possible to get into a state where the player character is continuously pushed upward toward the sky.

[b][i]Gun Loss[/i][/b] – The user is no longer able to lose access to one of their guns using toggle/hold controls by dropping guns after firing a Fusion Shot.


[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]: We are investigating these issues and hope to have fixes for these soon. If you encounter any of these, please help us by reporting the issue ([url=http://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/] Bug Report Form[/url])
[list]
    [*]In multiplayer, some users may encounter an issue where either the host or client can lose voice chat while transitioning between levels. Restarting the application should restore voicechat functionality.
    [*]When loading into Mission 4 - Nuke Fusion, the client has a small chance of crashing. Please submit any crash reports that are generated from this.
    [*]Spamming the different Leaderboard lists (especially those without scores) has the potential to freeze the game. 
    [*]There is a potential non-progression issue in Vapor Exploit on higher difficulties. Be sure to search the map carefully for any stuck bots. Screenshots of stuck bots are especially helpful with these issues.
    [*]Nitromo enemies can sometimes push players through level geometry when exploding, preventing them from being able to move. 
[/list]

And as always, we want to hear your ongoing thoughts on how we can better support your mission into Eden Corp! Join us on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/436320] Steam discussion forum[/url] and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official [url=http://survios.com/rawdata/feedback/] Feedback Form[/url] and [url=http://survios.com/rawdata/report-bug/] Bug Reporting Form[/url] to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck–we look forward to reviewing your latest reports!

Signing off,

Spencer

[i]EDIT:[/i] Check out our v.0.3 Dev Stream!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=755150008

Greetings, SyndiK8 operatives!

Before diving into all the good stuff, we wanted to thank you for helping make [i]Raw Data[/i] an amazing experience for us as developers. We love all your great feedback and honest opinions--please keep them coming! Addressing your feedback and evolving the game with you is very important to us, and in order to properly accomplish this goal, we’ll be adjusting our update release calendar to emphasize quality over quantity. We’ll still deliver tons of new content, but across fewer (but larger!) updates.

Now onto the awesome news: we have a [i]Raw Data[/i] update coming this month! And guys, it’s a big one. Early Access Update 0.3 will include:
[list]
[*]New mission in never-before-seen Eden Corp environment
[*]New and improved enemies
[*]New deployable defense type
[*]New difficulty system
[*]Leaderboards
[*]...and much more!
[/list]

Here’s a sneak peek of some of the fresh content coming your way…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/34a7f7d239530f6f25b840700fbac5df2c7ecadc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Update v0.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1a354adeadfaf5b5263c5100b34754a8c79c27a1.jpg[/img]

Greetings, SyndiK8 operatives!

The data we’ve been collecting from your ventures into Eden Corp have been invaluable. Thanks to your ongoing feedback and reports, we’ve been able to put together our first big update for your mission.

From new abilities for both Bishop and Saija to improved weapon mechanics to a much-requested light source for a certain mission--we’ve heard you! Here's what's just been implemented in [i]Raw Data[/i]:

[b][i]New Content / Functionality[/i][/b]
[list]
    [*]Bishop: New Hero Ability - [b][i]Fusion Charged Shot[/i][/b]. Players must steal the technology from Eden Corp and purchase it from the Hero selection screen.
    [*]Saija: New Hero Ability - [b][i]Telekinesis[/i][/b]. Players must steal the technology from Eden Corp and purchase it from the Hero selection screen.
    [*]Ninja Bot: New Enemy Ability -  Stealth. Will allow him to sneak up on players more easily.
    [*]Dark Source: Flashlight functionality has been added. Automatically activates at mission start on Bishop’s pistol and Saija’s Flash Blade.
    [*]Added volume and mute controls for voice chat in the in-game options menu.
    [*]Game Start sequences can now be skipped through with button input allowing players to get to the Showroom quicker. (Skip functionality is disabled for first-time game startup.)
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/c73b0c7d79824c16b623262a143e366d93d9a69c.gif[/img]
[i]Saija shows off her new illuminated Flash Blade on Dark Source[/i].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/e86b56549fdfc1bc54f3bdc5a8caaf295cd3ccf2.gif[/img]
[i]Bishop lights up Dark Source with newly added flashlights and Fusion Charged Shot[/i].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6fb5578566a033699a2086ec6a2ec7e207a1cf5d.gif[/img]
[i]Go robo-bowling with Saija's new single-target Telekinesis ability[/i].

[b][i]Gameplay Improvements / Balance[/i][/b]
[list]
    [*]Dark Source mission difficulty has been slightly reduced.
    [*]Data Core health has been slightly increased.
    [*]Teleshift now maintains player embodiment during movement, allowing players to melee attack/slice through enemies while Teleshifting.
    [*]A buffer zone around enemies has been added to help prevent Teleshifting too close.
    [*]Teleshifting is now limited with a stamina system to improve game balance.
    [*]Decreased pistol reloading distance and increased speed of reload animation. The reload animation can also now be interrupted by moving your hand away during the sequence.
    [*]Improved crawler vomit VFX to increase player awareness. Also decreased the time before the Crawler vomits on the player.
    [*]Updated VFX for Saija’s Flash Blade, including trails.
    [*]Improved Flash Blade hit reactions by making them bigger and more responsive to help with player feedback.  
    [*]Improved pistol fire SFX.
    [*]Improved Bulletstorm VFX.
    [*]New fade-out material on view model of player avatar arms added.
    [*]Revamped ability cooldown/energy indicator UI. Gravity Thrust and Shurikens have temporary energy meters that are only visible on hand when triggering ability. Special Ability button UI now also has cooldown meters integrated.
    [*]Ability popup in the main menu now has information about controls and a link to the controls page.
    [*]Main menu now displays current number of players online. 
[/list]

[b][i]Fixes[/i][/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue that was preventing all open games from displaying in the multiplayer game search UI based on geographic proximity.
    [*]Fix implemented to prevent accidental pistol and ammo clip swapping.
    [*]Fixed an issue where the Crawler enemy was not always aligning properly to the front of the player.
[/list]

Want to review the new abilities? Check out the latest [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80tmaqdAqKU&feature=gp-n-y&google_comment_id=z12iwb0z0oihvt04a04cd5cjdtazw1wrd2o] Survios dev stream[/url] where we highlight some of the main features & fixes in Update v0.2. Follow [url=twitch.tv/survios] Survios on Twitch[/url] to stay tuned for all dev streams! 

And as always, we want to hear your ongoing thoughts on how we can better support your mission into Eden Corp! Join us on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/436320] Steam discussion forum[/url] and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official [url=http://rawdatagame.com/feedback/]  Feedback Form[/url] and [url=http://rawdatagame.com/report-bug/] Bug Reporting Form[/url] to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck--we look forward to reviewing your latest reports!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/56b8fa967e89a12c5e5126b5ba48953e251228eb.gif[/img]
[i]Bonus Gif! Timewarp + Fusion Charged Shot is a beautiful combo![/i]


[i]EDIT:[/i] Check out our Update v.0.2 Dev Stream!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=755141413
