notes.title: Parsing Raw Data: Creation of Saija
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/0b99eb39da85dfba181cbe4d4544c3529d81a9de.jpg[/img]

You’ve [url=http://survios.com/parsing-raw-data-bishop/] met Bishop[/url], and earlier you got [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-saija/]an in-depth look[/url] at all of Saija’s gravity-manipulation abilities that make her so much more than just a melee class. Just like with Bishop, we wanted to share our inspiration for Raw Data’s distinctive take on the classic ninja archetype, playing with how she would embody the well-honed tropes while also standing out as a unique interpretation.

She’s also become such an iconic figure for us during development that we made her the star of Raw Data’s cover art.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8876b6023f3a408d455da7bfb2f2db1bda4b2c67.jpg[/img]

The concept of a tech-enhanced ninja is so well-suited to Raw Data’s futuristic Neo-Shinjuku setting that it was basically part of the game from the start. Even the earliest demos of the game featured the fan-favorite Flash Blade, because--simply put--everyone feels badass wielding a katana.

But our ninja needed to be much more than just a martial artist clad in black. You’ve probably already noticed that Saija sports a bit more armor than her gun-wielding compatriot.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/63fd9b526ae9d3d638d00eaf04606681e4a3a610.jpg[/img]

As one of SyndiK8’s elite operatives, Saija walks the line between being a spy in the shadows and a fighter on the front lines: a marriage of the ancient discipline of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ninjutsu] Ninjutsu[/url] with the samurai code of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bushido] Bushido[/url]. In the Raw Data universe, Ninjutsu has evolved to stand toe-to-toe with advanced weaponry by including mental mastery among its practices.

Along with refined swordplay and incredible physical prowess, practitioners of modern Ninjutsu are also telekinetic thanks to point-cloud neural nanomachines. How can a gun compete with someone who’s able to not only deflect the bullet, but pick up the shooter and fling him away?

During the concept art process, Saija wasn’t even referred to as a ninja--her codename was “Knight,” and with her suit of futuristic armor, it wasn’t that far-fetched of a moniker.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/407787c0824deb0c8f1e0194e71cde1510fa54e5.jpg[/img]

In a sharp contrast to Bishop, Saija is completely shielded from head to toe in form-fitting armor that explicitly reads as such. It needed to be equal parts protective and agile, so we went for a chitinous appearance that suggests interlocking yet flexible plates of carbon fiber and strong vinyl.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8f43566c72a5e2bd05d5ec836bf14b518e302de1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/36c203064e4232d9a73ed5d50c717c7f8905f789.jpg[/img]

Saija’s suit also gained a helmet for complete head coverage, transforming her into the consummate faceless assassin.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/695ccf7856f4ad2c9fbfc4fdeee78fe84cd54ac8.jpg[/img]

A basic katana wouldn’t cut it (literally), so Saija uses the latest in blade-honing technology. Her retractable energy-powered Flash Blade features an advanced harmonizing wave-dynamic effector grind, providing sharpness on an atomic scale. In simple terms: it slices through everything unfortunate enough to come into contact with it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/bd661e4370152e318282c8e2a711eb07d5ca2d33.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/67fe9445ac44196bd188c01e37b167360bf83c3f.gif[/img]

As mentioned before, while Saija is easy to classify as a melee hero because of her Flash Blade, her true strength lies in that perfect balance of physical and mental power. Playing as Saija means you have to always be aware of positioning (Teleshift is essential), plan your ability timing well, and not be afraid to get up close and personal with Eden’s vicious synthetics (read the full ability rundown in [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-saija/] our complete Saija hero feature[/url]):
[list]
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/Boomerang.gif] Katana Throw[/url] transforms the Flash Blade into a ranged weapon: a sharp spinning boomerang with a controllable flight path that slices through enemies both going and coming.
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/ForcePush.gif] Gravity Thrust[/url] unleashes a wave of energy that can knock enemies backward, shove them aside, or even yank them forward for when you’re feeling particularly stabby.
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/LevitationSmash_OnHeavy.gif] Levitation Smash[/url], Saija’s ultimate, lets you rise above the battle--then come crashing back down with a devastating energy blast in all directions.
[/list]

Saija is a challenge to play, but there’s a reason she’s the go-to hero on the Survios dev team. ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=725406741]See their tips and tricks for playing both her and Bishop![/url]) With her gravity-defying telekinetic abilities and kickass blade, Raw Data’s Cyber Ninja adds a new level of adrenaline to VR gameplay. Choose Saija for your SyndiK8 team and experience how it feels to cut down your enemies, see them strewn before you, and hear the sizzling death knells of robots forcefully powering down.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/33b9eca84d7a3d03b9d4b4496dd3a5d3b2e9bb76.jpg[/img]

You’ve [url=http://survios.com/parsing-raw-data-bishop/] met Bishop[/url], and earlier you got [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-saija/]an in-depth look[/url] at all of Saija’s gravity-manipulation abilities that make her so much more than just a melee class. She’s also become such an iconic figure for us during development that we made her the star of Raw Data’s cover art.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8876b6023f3a408d455da7bfb2f2db1bda4b2c67.jpg[/img]

The concept of a tech-enhanced ninja is so well-suited to Raw Data’s futuristic Neo-Shinjuku setting that it was basically part of the game from the start. Even the earliest demos of the game featured the fan-favorite Flash Blade, because--simply put--everyone feels badass wielding a katana.

But our ninja needed to be much more than just a martial artist clad in black. You’ve probably already noticed that Saija sports a bit more armor than her gun-wielding compatriot.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/63fd9b526ae9d3d638d00eaf04606681e4a3a610.jpg[/img]

As one of SyndiK8’s elite operatives, Saija walks the line between being a spy in the shadows and a fighter on the front lines: a marriage of the ancient discipline of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ninjutsu] Ninjutsu[/url] with the samurai code of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bushido] Bushido[/url]. In the Raw Data universe, Ninjutsu has evolved to stand toe-to-toe with advanced weaponry by including mental mastery among its practices.

Along with refined swordplay and incredible physical prowess, practitioners of modern Ninjutsu are also telekinetic thanks to point-cloud neural nanomachines. How can a gun compete with someone who’s able to not only deflect the bullet, but pick up the shooter and fling him away?

During the concept art process, Saija wasn’t even referred to as a ninja--her codename was “Knight,” and with her suit of futuristic armor, it wasn’t that far-fetched of a moniker.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/407787c0824deb0c8f1e0194e71cde1510fa54e5.jpg[/img]

In a sharp contrast to Bishop, Saija is completely shielded from head to toe in form-fitting armor that explicitly reads as such. It needed to be equal parts protective and agile, so we went for a chitinous appearance that suggests interlocking yet flexible plates of carbon fiber and strong vinyl.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8f43566c72a5e2bd05d5ec836bf14b518e302de1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/36c203064e4232d9a73ed5d50c717c7f8905f789.jpg[/img]

Saija’s suit also gained a helmet for complete head coverage, transforming her into the consummate faceless assassin.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/695ccf7856f4ad2c9fbfc4fdeee78fe84cd54ac8.jpg[/img]

A basic katana wouldn’t cut it (literally), so Saija uses the latest in blade-honing technology. Her retractable energy-powered Flash Blade features an advanced harmonizing wave-dynamic effector grind, providing sharpness on an atomic scale. In simple terms: it slices through everything unfortunate enough to come into contact with it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/bd661e4370152e318282c8e2a711eb07d5ca2d33.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/67fe9445ac44196bd188c01e37b167360bf83c3f.gif[/img]

As mentioned before, while Saija is easy to classify as a melee hero because of her Flash Blade, her true strength lies in that perfect balance of physical and mental power. Playing as Saija means you have to always be aware of positioning (Teleshift is essential), plan your ability timing well, and not be afraid to get up close and personal with Eden’s vicious synthetics (read the full ability rundown in [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-saija/] our complete Saija hero feature[/url]):
[list]
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/Boomerang.gif] Katana Throw[/url] transforms the Flash Blade into a ranged weapon: a sharp spinning boomerang with a controllable flight path that slices through enemies both going and coming.
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/ForcePush.gif] Gravity Thrust[/url] unleashes a wave of energy that can knock enemies backward, shove them aside, or even yank them forward for when you’re feeling particularly stabby.
    [*][url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/LevitationSmash_OnHeavy.gif] Levitation Smash[/url], Saija’s ultimate, lets you rise above the battle--then come crashing back down with a devastating energy blast in all directions.
[/list]

Saija is a challenge to play, but there’s a reason she’s the go-to hero on the Survios dev team. ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=725406741]See their tips and tricks for playing both her and Bishop![/url]) With her gravity-defying telekinetic abilities and kickass blade, Raw Data’s Cyber Ninja adds a new level of adrenaline to VR gameplay. Choose Saija for your SyndiK8 team and experience how it feels to cut down your enemies, see them strewn before you, and hear the sizzling death knells of robots forcefully powering down.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/33b9eca84d7a3d03b9d4b4496dd3a5d3b2e9bb76.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Raw Data Hero Spotlight: Saija, the Cyber Ninja
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/040d314e6b39f64aaedff110c864a8e012a0218e.jpg[/img]

Hello, and welcome to the second Raw Data hero spotlight! In this series, we’ll give you insight into how SyndiK8’s top operatives utilize nanotechnology to gain enhanced abilities, both through their weapons and with their minds.

Raw Data’s Early Access build comes with two SyndiK8 heroes: Bishop and Saija. We went over Bishop’s [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-bishop/] loadout[/url] and [url=http://survios.com/parsing-raw-data-bishop/] development[/url] last week. Today, it’s time to meet Saija, the Cyber Ninja.

Saija is the second of two starting heroes in Raw Data (more to come!) and is our melee-oriented player character. When you hear the word ninja, what usually comes to mind? Shadows, stealthiness, lightning-fast reflexes?

Well, Saija definitely has the latter, but as for the former–she’s a bit more in-your-face than the typical ninja trope. That’s thanks to her discipline of telekinetic Ninjutsu, an ideal marriage of enhanced physical prowess with well-honed psychic abilities.


[i][b] In a Flash[/b][/i]

The core of Saija’s loadout is the fan favorite [b] Flash Blade[/b], a futuristic energy katana that uses a contained energy beam to slice through robots like butter. It can always be found behind your back, reachable over your shoulder, and can be wielded with one or both hands. Holding with both hands will activate the supercharged blade, which gives tons of extra damage to each swing.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/5ce195b7915cbf272934680a4bc025e6088b9b0c.gif[/img]

The katana’s power is derived from you–the harder you swing, the more damage you’ll do when it connects. No wimpy sword waggling allowed here!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6f6c12fb9e000e49b16606116051fc4baf971407.gif[/img]


[i][b] Return to Sender[/b][/i]

The Flash Blade is much more versatile than it initially appears: the energy blade deflects as well as slices and dices. In addition to charging the blade, holding it with both hands will also activate [b] Bullet Counter[/b], which greatly magnifies its deflection accuracy and precision. [i] Tip: Make sure to swing hard at projectiles to effectively counter enemy fire.[/i] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a67feb58c079553a8de8d18ff523efdc198a0652.gif[/img]

When you feel surrounded, this is an effective way to protect yourself and send your enemies’ projectiles back at them in a deadly reversal of fortune. However, this is strictly situational; you’ll soon learn why keeping one hand free is crucial to play Saija.

As you rack up the mission accomplishments, Saija will unlock her [b] Shuriken Stream[/b], fired from whatever arm isn’t holding her Flash Blade (shown here in combo with Katana Throw).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3f42266a9be7bb43877097dad78e4991689a06f2.gif[/img]

A quick squeeze-and-hold of the Trigger will unleash a brief onslaught of ethereal ninja stars that will tear apart whatever enemy is unfortunate enough to be in its path.


[i][b] Free Your Mind[/b][/i]

What makes Saija so much more than a typical melee class isn’t just her crazy beam sword. Her psychic abilities manifest themselves in multiple effective methods of literally get enemies off your back.

For example, when Hornet Drones or hordes of enemies appear, Saija’s Flash Blade doubles as a ranged weapon–albeit one you guide with your mind. [b] Katana Throw[/b] transforms it into a sharp spinning boomerang with a controllable flight path.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/980eec38b855a8ca831cbcb4609229a020bf7db8.gif[/img]

Make a throwing gesture and release the Grip buttons, then wave your hand to direct it–you’ll send your sword hurtling through enemies, cutting them up both going and returning. The angle of your throw also defines the angle of the spinning blade, allowing you to cut through many enemies horizontally, or vanquishing a foe from head to foot with a well-placed vertical sword toss.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7e85e1e6922246398f54d7213eed1ed9adce453f.gif[/img]

But her powers aren’t limited to her weapon: Saija also focuses her powers to turn her enemies into her weapons. Unlocked through game progression, [b] Gravity Thrust[/b] gives you perspective on the gravity of the situation, in that you can manipulate it to throw enemies around like ragdolls.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ee8e9d9f8189eea9b00c1c4338a61cc2c6fb526c.gif[/img]

Despite its name, Gravity Thrust works in all directions: sure, you can knock enemies backwards (and hopefully off a walkway or into another robot), but you can also toss them sideways and–if you want to execute a coup de grâce–pull them toward you onto your Flash Blade.

Or you can always throw it at them, too:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b023530905139bb93701c2cceb3e95d24fe260e6.gif[/img]


[i][b] Let's Break It Down![/b][/i]

In the current Early Access build, Saija has one Ultimate, and to give you an idea of how it works, all we have to say is this: [i] Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6ae96b69d5aa7b3aa36c5d9e43eea7632a199e0b.gif[/img]

[b] Levitation Smash[/b] is the pinnacle of Saija’s gravity-manipulation prowess. You’ll rise up and float above the battlefield, and just when you’re enjoying the view (of several pairs of robot eyes goggling at you), it’s time to return to Earth. With a devastating area-of-effect energy blast.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/6c1a0213b258a29968ecd83835361d99635e6272.gif[/img]

Yes, this even deals a hefty blow to the super-heavy Dynomo robots. Save it up and unleash it when you’re surrounded–your enemies will be blown away faster than you can shout, “Welcome to the jam!”


[i][b] Puppetmaster[/b][/i]

Coming up in a future content patch, Saija’s second Ultimate is the aptly-named [b] Telekinesis[/b]. Think of it as the much more powerful big brother of Gravity Thrust, because instead of just a blast of directed gravity, you can actually pick up an enemy of your choice and jettison them into the crowd like a rocket.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/e87a5a3817b518da821a75afa0eb2c39ca2cb766.gif[/img]

Usable at a great distance, your victim is completely at your mercy. Throw it into other enemies? Sure. Slam it down on the ground from an absurd height? Of course. Hurl it off the side into oblivion? Aww yeah.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/59c94fe593769289348ffbe2fc538a3153c0a734.gif[/img]

When you’re thinking NOPE, Telekinesis will be your go-to.


[i][b] Perfect Harmony[/b][/i]

While Saija is initially more difficult to play, she soon lives up to her SyndiK8 operative classification as a lethal ninja assassin. The key to her effectiveness is to not be afraid to get close to enemies: Teleshift to get within melee range, then quickly escape and activate ranged abilities. Hit ‘em quick, get out fast!

And like with Bishop, special ability combos are crucial for those big multi-enemy kills:

Gravity Thrust + Katana Throw: blast enemies away from you, then finish them off with a well-directed boomerang

Katana Throw + Shuriken Stream: a deadly duo of bladed ranged projectiles that can take out Hornet Drones and thin out large enemy groups

Gravity Thrust + Teleshift + Levitation Smash: knock them back, rush up, and slam down for a double dose of heavy AOE damage

You’ll soon be pulling off satisfying superhuman results that’ll leave you going, “Gun? Who needs a gun?”

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8d595442a19dd15f3be656f4a027ee6484f73c18.gif[/img]

Next in our Raw Data hero spotlight series: a look at Saija’s inspiration and design development, and a sneak peek at the upcoming shotgun-toting Street Merc (still in SyndiK8 operative training).

notes.title: Survive Hordes Of Robots In VR Gunfighter Raw Data
notes.content:
VR games are clogging up Steam’s Early Access list like cholesterol these days. Well, here comes another one. Raw Data [official site] is a survival-mode shooter that pits you (and a friend if you’ve got one) against wave after wave of malevolent robots. Using a laser katana to deflect their shots and your own selection of firearms to shoot back, you have to survive for as long as it takes to download one “geopbyte” of data from Eden Corp’s mainframes. I hope you’re using a good USB stick. Come see the trailer.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Raw Data Now Live on Steam Early Access! + Roadmap
notes.content:

notes.title: Parsing Raw Data: Creation of Bishop
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/2864627f1874522ba76e74d0af9fbf62c17b4faf.jpg[/img]

Now that you’ve gotten a [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-bishop/] GIF-heavy dose of Bishop’s weapons and abilities [/url], we’re sharing a bit of the development process behind our interpretation of the traditional gunslinger character, updated and revamped for Raw Data‘s immersive world and VR gameplay.

With Bishop, we wanted to create a classic gun-wielding hero that embodied all of our favorite trigger-happy action movies, but with a thematic twist that suited Raw Data‘s futuristic Asian fusion culture and setting. That’s where [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hong_Kong_action_cinema] Hong Kong action cinema [/url] came in–its characteristic stylized shootouts were a perfect fit–and, when merged with our favorite flicks from the action sci-fi genre, we had Bishop, SyndiK8’s elite Gun Cleric.

In personality, Bishop possesses an almost religious mystique, clearly motivated by righteous ideals and ready to take down anything that violates his moral code or stands in the way of human purity. Even early on, we started exploring a simple, neutral design for Bishop’s costume featuring white as the predominant color and minimizing the look of tech and armor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/eff69cc137dcfbc2412333079bf1353023a6edb7.jpg[/img]

Because of his strict training and beliefs, Bishop needed to look sophisticated, centered, and confident, even in the face of grave danger. With this as motivation, we eventually arrived at his final outfit. The clean lines of the tailored Nehru jacket (complete with mandarin collar) and subtle textures hinting at advanced armor further reflect the precision and zeal of a martial artist.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f7ffe385f3e1dc180ebb51eba6358b481c871da8.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1937a51b5bad2e3ff7dae1628ca057d4875b1537.jpg[/img]

We originally toyed with giving Bishop sense-enhancing facial accessories, which would be expected in Raw Data‘s society, but eventually decided against it. As a Gun Fu master, Bishop wouldn’t need to rely on technology to improve his aim.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ef86fb82e2f3f4a3c5bdbdae4e0efbf0d08af9d8.jpg[/img]

Similarly, Bishop’s Crusader 10mm pistol is deceptively simple in appearance, looking like a classic heavy one-hander. The exposed bullets in the clip is our one touch that hints at the true punch this pistol packs.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/9f3d129c93414aee0de311f017c9141140df785e.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/2b73fb0f0f07e2917360d3aafc8c8c1942e84a62.jpg[/img]

In our opinion, nothing says “futuristic gunslinger” than martial arts combined with firearms: the classic “[url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gun_fu]Gun Fu [/url]” style. We wanted Bishop’s special abilities to encourage players to embody this type of “bullet ballet” physical motion (read more in [url=http://survios.com/rd-hero-profile-bishop/] our complete Bishop hero feature [/url]):

[url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/Bishop_TimewarpTeleport.gif] Timewarp [/url] gives players precious extra moments to blow back enemies in slow motion, while enjoying the sparks and muzzle flashes and bullet trails in all their glory for a touch of cinematic flair.

[url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/Bishop_ChargedShotDouble_Bots.gif] Charged Shot [/url] delivers deadly piercing power for only a second of buildup. Holding your fire is doubly effective when you fire off simultaneous Charged Shots from dual pistols, and the destruction dealt by the upcoming Fusion Charged Shot special ability will prove that patience pays off.

Finally, with [url=http://survios.com/content/uploads/2016/07/Bishop_Bulletstorm-1.gif] Bulletstorm [/url], you can mow down everything in a hail of bullets, many times provoking players to spin around and switch up aiming in multiple directions, feeling like a true badass akimbo master.


And here he is, in the final render you will see in-game (plus a bonus action shot, because why not?). Well, if you play as Bishop you’ll mostly just see his hands and guns, but you’ll get to enjoy Bishop’s character model in action if you’re teamed up with him. Effective and efficient, Bishop is always a solid choice for any SyndiK8 mission, so choose him and let your guns guide the way.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/9f35ad3643998b7233a0c1fc9c78f291b62db780.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/471ccc06c0e234bf67e71f8ec3196d99bf075d6a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Raw Data Hero Spotlight: Bishop, the Gun Cleric
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ff62b75ed8ea7d779df918370b64be2f05d103c5.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the first Raw Data hero spotlight! In this series, we’ll give you insight into how SyndiK8’s top operatives utilize nanotechnology to gain enhanced abilities, both through their weapons and with their minds.

Raw Data’s Early Access build comes with two SyndiK8 heroes: Bishop and Saija. Today, we’re going over the loadout for Bishop, the Gun Cleric.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/5c612a12fe17db22e9713c837c77551de03cde9a.jpg[/img]

Bishop is one of two starting heroes you can choose from (more heroes to come), and he’s a lot more than a basic run-and-gun guy–he’s a master practitioner of Gun Fu who channels energy through his akimbo pistols, turning any shootout into a ballet of bullets at superhuman speeds.


[b] (Pistol) Whip It [/b]

Bishop’s starting loadout includes his pistol of choice: the powerful [b]Crusader 10mm[/b]. It fires as fast as you can pull the trigger, and its slugs pack a serious punch. You’ll always find the Crusader on your dominant hip, with a 15-bullet magazine on the other at the ready for rapid reloads.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/169f3a586cc014e240a90de5b588545ba6c36abb.gif[/img]

As the game progresses, you’ll have the option to unlock [b]Dual Pistols[/b], and why wouldn’t you? A true Gun Fu master always goes akimbo.

Another ability Bishop gains in the game is the [b] Proximity Reload[/b] ability, which skips the whole “insert the clip” step and just automatically reloads the pistol when you touch it to your hip or lower back. Precious seconds saved to get you back in the fray!

Yes, you can pistol-whip enemies with it, or throw the gun at them. The gun excels in close and medium range combat, so go ahead and let those Eden Corp synthetics get nice and close…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b1e179f20584616d09201980aa3cacedcf5966f3.gif[/img]

Well, maybe not that close. So: load, aim, shoot–that’s it, right? Not so fast.


[b]Charrrrggggeeee![/b]

One of Bishop’s weapon-based abilities is [b] Charged Shot[/b], which fires a powerful slug that penetrates nearly any surface and deals deadly piercing damage to multiple assailants. This is the most efficient, effective way to quickly blow a hole in something you don’t want coming too close.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/da819c53e3ace98ef55f181ccc0fd033eec62fa9.gif[/img]

A well-aimed Charged Shot can one-shot Hornet Drones and, with careful aim, take out most basic synthetic models. Just hold the Trigger down for a brief period to fully charge your gun before shooting. And, as you can see, a double Charged Shot with dual pistols is super effective.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a04f6b855a804ce3067dda49e895538fd24182cf.gif[/img]

Most of Raw Data’s abilities have unlockable upgrades, and Charged Shot is no exception. Although not available in the initial Early Access release build, soon Bishop will be able to unleash a [b] Fusion Charged Shot[/b] that utilizes dual Charged Shots to release an unblockable, unstoppable blast of energy.


[b] One with the Gun [/b]

However, Bishop wouldn’t be an elite SyndiK8 operative if all he did was just pepper-spray enemies with bullets. That’s where the nano-enhanced special abilities come into play. These punchy powers can turn the tide in a fight, so keep an eye on their cooldowns on your in-game forearm display; you’ll want them ready should you get overwhelmed.

First of these is another sci-fi classic: let’s do the [b]Timewarp[/b] again! Our take on bullettime slows down time for a few crucial seconds, so you can use the rare gift of more time to do all sorts of actions: set up a Charged Shot, build an extra turret, or–if the situation is truly dire–GTFO via Teleport (available for all heroes).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/e483df3ac5f7c6620a17cc48bfe4ce5b7f0de640.gif[/img]

Eden Corp doesn’t believe in subtlety, so they prefer to send out their droves of synthetics in sizable hordes. While strength in numbers is usually effective, it meets its downfall when Bishop activates [b]Bulletstorm[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/00968a9c8e868d196533bb0b331887992e1ed13c.gif[/img]

An automatic fiery barrage of self-replicating nano rounds, Bulletstorm not only delivers a massive amount of damage to anything unfortunate enough to be in its way, but it does so without depleting your ammo. So once the insanity’s over, you can continue to put bullets in whatever’s still left standing. How’s that for efficiency?


[b]Mix & Match[/b]

Bishop is not just a great starter character for someone new to Raw Data (or new to VR gaming in general), but a solid choice in any SyndiK8 team. It never hurts to have some firepower, and when Bishop pairs up his abilities, the results–heaps of scrap where synthetics once stood–speak for themselves.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3359d3aae5bed679dc018d1cef097f435bcbfc5f.gif[/img]

When you’ve gotten the hang of Bishop’s abilities, try these combos for deadly results:


Timewarp + Teleport: get into the perfect position to line up that fatal headshot

Timewarp + Bulletstorm: slow down time and mow down enemies like they’re standing still

Timewarp + Charged Shot: excellent for one-shotting crawlers or exploders

Charged Shot + Teleport: charge up your shot, then teleport to an enemy to unleash it at close range (and damage any enemies behind it)


Have fun with your first takes on Gun Fu, and stay tuned for our next spotlight on Saija, the Cyber Ninja who favors an in-your-face attack strategy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/cd9d6dc6044987c5b41d7121aafa7f59a2b2d4a3.gif[/img]

P.S. And of course you can do gun tricks. Consider this our unofficial challenge to see what you can come up with!

[b] (Pistol) Whip It [/b]

Bishop’s starting loadout includes his pistol of choice: the powerful [b]Crusader 10mm[/b]. It fires as fast as you can pull the trigger, and its slugs pack a serious punch. You’ll always find the Crusader on your dominant hip, with a 15-bullet magazine on the other at the ready for rapid reloads.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/169f3a586cc014e240a90de5b588545ba6c36abb.gif[/img]

As the game progresses, you’ll have the option to unlock [b]Dual Pistols[/b], and why wouldn’t you? A true Gun Fu master always goes akimbo.

Another ability Bishop gains in the game is the [b] Proximity Reload[/b] ability, which skips the whole “insert the clip” step and just automatically reloads the pistol when you touch it to your hip or lower back. Precious seconds saved to get you back in the fray!

Yes, you can pistol-whip enemies with it, or throw the gun at them. The gun excels in close and medium range combat, so go ahead and let those Eden Corp synthetics get nice and close…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b1e179f20584616d09201980aa3cacedcf5966f3.gif[/img]

Well, maybe not that close. So: load, aim, shoot–that’s it, right? Not so fast.


[b]Charrrrggggeeee![/b]

One of Bishop’s weapon-based abilities is [b] Charged Shot[/b], which fires a powerful slug that penetrates nearly any surface and deals deadly piercing damage to multiple assailants. This is the most efficient, effective way to quickly blow a hole in something you don’t want coming too close.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/da819c53e3ace98ef55f181ccc0fd033eec62fa9.gif[/img]

A well-aimed Charged Shot can one-shot Hornet Drones and, with careful aim, take out most basic synthetic models. Just hold the Trigger down for a brief period to fully charge your gun before shooting. And, as you can see, a double Charged Shot with dual pistols is super effective.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a04f6b855a804ce3067dda49e895538fd24182cf.gif[/img]

Most of Raw Data’s abilities have unlockable upgrades, and Charged Shot is no exception. Although not available in the initial Early Access release build, soon Bishop will be able to unleash a [b] Fusion Charged Shot[/b] that utilizes dual Charged Shots to release an unblockable, unstoppable blast of energy.


[b] One with the Gun [/b]

However, Bishop wouldn’t be an elite SyndiK8 operative if all he did was just pepper-spray enemies with bullets. That’s where the nano-enhanced special abilities come into play. These punchy powers can turn the tide in a fight, so keep an eye on their cooldowns on your in-game forearm display; you’ll want them ready should you get overwhelmed.

First of these is another sci-fi classic: let’s do the [b]Timewarp[/b] again! Our take on bullettime slows down time for a few crucial seconds, so you can use the rare gift of more time to do all sorts of actions: set up a Charged Shot, build an extra turret, or–if the situation is truly dire–GTFO via Teleport (available for all heroes).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/e483df3ac5f7c6620a17cc48bfe4ce5b7f0de640.gif[/img]

Eden Corp doesn’t believe in subtlety, so they prefer to send out their droves of synthetics in sizable hordes. While strength in numbers is usually effective, it meets its downfall when Bishop activates [b]Bulletstorm[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/00968a9c8e868d196533bb0b331887992e1ed13c.gif[/img]

An automatic fiery barrage of self-replicating nano rounds, Bulletstorm not only delivers a massive amount of damage to anything unfortunate enough to be in its way, but it does so without depleting your ammo. So once the insanity’s over, you can continue to put bullets in whatever’s still left standing. How’s that for efficiency?


[b]Mix & Match[/b]

Bishop is not just a great starter character for someone new to Raw Data (or new to VR gaming in general), but a solid choice in any SyndiK8 team. It never hurts to have some firepower, and when Bishop pairs up his abilities, the results–heaps of scrap where synthetics once stood–speak for themselves.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3359d3aae5bed679dc018d1cef097f435bcbfc5f.gif[/img]

When you’ve gotten the hang of Bishop’s abilities, try these combos for deadly results:


Timewarp + Teleport: get into the perfect position to line up that fatal headshot

Timewarp + Bulletstorm: slow down time and mow down enemies like they’re standing still

Timewarp + Charged Shot: excellent for one-shotting crawlers or exploders

Charged Shot + Teleport: charge up your shot, then teleport to an enemy to unleash it at close range (and damage any enemies behind it)


Have fun with your first takes on Gun Fu, and stay tuned for our next spotlight on Saija, the Cyber Ninja who favors an in-your-face attack strategy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/cd9d6dc6044987c5b41d7121aafa7f59a2b2d4a3.gif[/img]

P.S. And of course you can do gun tricks. Consider this our unofficial challenge to see what you can come up with!

notes.title: Welcome to RAW DATA Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/53f619139dfdb44fd8c97ae544c729271a7345a0.jpg[/img]

Greetings, SyndiK8 operatives! I’m Spencer, and I’ll be your sensei here on the official Raw Data Steam community! With Early Access coming out July 14--officially less than a week--the Survios team wanted to connect with everyone and share what we’ve got coming up.

If you’re active within the community, you’ve probably already noticed that several of the Survios devs are already here--say hi, guys! Going forward, consider yourselves honorary members of the Survios dev team, because you guys are an integral part of the journey from Early Access to final release. We’ll be answering your questions and passing feedback along to ensure Raw Data is the most immersive, compelling, and complete VR title you’ve ever experienced.

Along with keeping you regularly updated here on Steam, we’ll also be sharing exclusive news and content* on Survios’ social media channels--[url=https://twitter.com/Survios?ref_src=twsrc%5Egoogle%7Ctwcamp%5Eserp%7Ctwgr%5Eauthor]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/survios/] Instagram	[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/surviosvr/] Facebook	[/url]--plus prepping the official [url=http://survios.com/blog/] Survios Blog	[/url] with dev insights, game feature spotlights, and more.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f5a222bdf7813125da0c46f0e2e76e6e15463c4c.gif[/img]
Shout out to @NoMercyLeroy for this brilliant example of VRBadassery

[i]*That includes awesome content made by you guys. If you’ve got any amazing play videos, physics tricks, gifs, or fanart, we want to see it and share it!
[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/825cbd0c8edef8530ca08c60e5077df767119986.jpg[/img]

[b]WELCOME TO EDEN[/b]
What are some of the new features you can expect in Early Access? For starters, we’ve got four exciting missions you can undertake within Eden Corp’s expansive headquarters in Neo-Shinjuku. And every single one is packed with Eden’s deadliest killing machines, from standard-issue Automos to carpet-bombing Hornet Drones to heavy-hitting charging mechs and tons more.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/913e25f9be08cdfef4aafac246cbf382f62d8c9a.gif[/img]
Oh, and you can move. That’s right: teleportation has officially arrived in Raw Data. Get up close and personal with your flash blade, or blink away and riddle them with bullets from a distance: suiting every playstyle.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/a71e0e4f5af677584d85d87c88fe423319074803.gif[/img]

[b]SYNDIK8 RECRUITMENT[/b]
Early Access also introduces you to the first two SyndiK8 heroes with whom you’ll be infiltrating Eden Corp: Bishop, the pistol-wielding Gun Cleric, and Saija, the telekinetic Cyber Ninja. Their official operative dossiers are coming soon!

[b]SQUASHING BUGS & TAKING NAMES[/b]
Encounter something buggy or broken while in-game, or just have some feedback for us? Tell us about it! We’re also building out a support ticket system for exactly that; it will go live shortly on the RawDataGame.com website. We’ll share the link in a pinned post once it’s live!

[b]FIST BUMPS![/b]
The Steam VR community has been a huge source of inspiration for us getting to this point, so we wanted to take a moment and thank you all for sticking with us as we make Raw Data a reality. Trust us: we’re extremely excited to get this game into your hands, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on it.

Together, we’re going to make Raw Data one hell of a VR experience! Let’s do this!

Signing off,
Spencer & the Survios team

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/815ffb3c181591555a928a7bab22e0fb7ccbb54b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet up with Survios team at E3 2016!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

We're showing off Raw Data at E3 this week. If you are headed to the show, be sure to stop by the Indiecade booth to check out the co-op Raw Data experience on HTC Vive:

June 14-16: South Hall, Booth #623

Off the show floor, we'll be hosting Raw Data demos at E3 Live in HTC's booth on Tuesday, June 14, from 5-10pm. Head over to LA Live and say hi to Survios!

Plus, we are giving away three VR Ready PC Packages with an NVIDIA GTX 980 graphics card and Intel Core i7-6700K LGA 1151 desktop processor. If you are at E3, be sure to stop by our booth and enter to win :)

To enter, find a Survios representative at the Indiecade booth and fill out an official entry form. Winners will be randomly selected following the show and notified the week of June 20.

Hope to see you there!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/59b38ba3d21e081cf17ed483e5c58f372f94e820.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Contest: Win a RAW DATA Alpha key!
notes.content:
Greetings, operatives!

I'm coming to you from the social media side of Survios. I know you're all patiently waiting for the Early Access release of [i]Raw Data[/i], and trust us: we can't wait to show it to you.

That's why we're tiding you over with the chance to win a [i]Raw Data[/i] Alpha key!

From now through Sunday (at midnight PT), we want you to exercise your creativity and show off your sonic abilities on the following GIF from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XSJ0P1PYAUY]this Vive feature video[/url]:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/232c9864023f2610b6cf376d6e272a5c9ca3f142.gif[/img]

Yes, that's a Boomerang Katana! (And that's our community lead Spencer throwing it. [url=https://twitter.com/Survios/status/735208057689382912]Hi Spencer![/url]) And it needs a cool (or hilarious) sound effect. From Three Stooges noises to your best [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2yD4yDsiP4&t=0m15s]a cappella Inception[/url], we want to hear you!

Want to enter? Download the [url=https://twitter.com/Survios/status/738445514249801728]source video[/url] or use [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zumbrsQuibQ&feature=youtu.be]this YouTube link[/url]. Then, [url=https://twitter.com/Survios]follow us on Twitter[/url] and tweet @Survios with your take on the #BoomerangKatana noise!

We'll randomly choose and announce winners on Monday. GLHF!
